sentences.zh: 資治通鑑第049卷

translations.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 49.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 49.

sentences.zh: 【漢紀四十一】起柔兆敦牂，盡旃蒙單閼，凡十年。

translations.literal: 【Han Records 41】 From Rouzhao Dunxiang through Zhanmeng Danque—in all, ten years.
translations.idiomatic: 【Han Records 41】 From the first year of the Rouzhao cycle through the last year of the Zhanmeng cycle—ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，辛卯，以太尉張禹為太傅，司徒徐防為太尉，參錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day xinmao, the Grand Commandant Zhang Yu was made Grand Tutor, the Minister of Education Xu Fang was made Grand Commandant, and participated in recording Master of Writing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on xinmao day, Grand Commandant Zhang Yu was made Grand Tutor, Minister of Education Xu Fang was made Grand Commandant, and both recorded Master of Writing affairs.

sentences.zh: 太后以帝在襁褓，欲令重臣居禁內。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, because the emperor was in swaddling clothes, wished to have heavy ministers dwell within the forbidden precinct.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor was still in swaddling clothes, the empress dowager wished to station senior ministers inside the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 乃詔禹捨宮中，五日一歸府；

translations.literal: She thereupon ordered Yu to give up residence in the palace and return to his mansion once every five days;
translations.idiomatic: She then ordered Yu to leave the palace and return to his mansion once every five days;

sentences.zh: 每朝見，特贊，與三公絕席。

translations.literal: at each court audience he received special encomium and a seat separate from the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: at each audience he received special encomium and a seat apart from the Three Ducal Ministers.

sentences.zh: 封皇兄勝為平原王。

translations.literal: The emperor's elder brother Sheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's elder brother Sheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以光祿勳梁鮪為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the Household Master of the Heir Liang Jin was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Household Master of the Heir Liang Jin was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 三月，甲申，葬孝和皇帝於慎陵，廟曰穆宗。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiashen, Emperor Xiaoh of Han was buried at Shenling; his temple name was Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen day, Emperor He of Han was buried at Shenling; his temple name was Muzong.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，清河王慶、濟北王壽、河間王開、常山王章始就國；

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Prince Qing of Qinghe, Prince Shou of Jibei, Prince Kai of Hejian, and Prince Zhang of Changshan all first went to their states;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Princes Qing of Qinghe, Shou of Jibei, Kai of Hejian, and Zhang of Changshan all departed for their states;

sentences.zh: 太后特加慶以殊禮。

translations.literal: the empress dowager especially added special honors for Qing.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager granted Qing especially distinguished honors.

sentences.zh: 慶子祜，年十三，太后以帝幼弱，遠慮不虞，留祜與嫡母耿姬居清河邸。

translations.literal: Qing's son Hu, age thirteen—the empress dowager, because the emperor was young and weak and fearing unforeseen troubles, kept Hu with his legitimate mother Lady Ji to dwell at the Qinghe residence.
translations.idiomatic: Qing's son Hu, thirteen years old—the empress dowager, fearing trouble while the emperor was young and weak, kept Hu with his legitimate mother Lady Ji at the Qinghe residence in the capital.

sentences.zh: 耿姬，況之曾孫也；

translations.literal: Lady Ji was the great-granddaughter of Kuang;
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ji was Kuang's great-granddaughter;

sentences.zh: 祜母，犍為左姬也。

translations.literal: Hu's mother was the Left Lady of Qianwei.
translations.idiomatic: Hu's mother was the Left Lady of Qianwei.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，鮮卑寇漁陽，漁陽太守張顯率數百人出塞追之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the Xianbei raided Yuyang. The Administrator of Yuyang Zhang Xian led several hundred men out of the passes in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, the Xianbei raided Yuyang. Administrator Zhang Xian led several hundred men beyond the frontier in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 兵馬掾嚴授諫曰：「前道險阻，賊勢難量，宜且結營，先令輕騎偵視之。

translations.literal: Military Clerk Yan Shou remonstrated, saying, "The road ahead is perilous and narrow; the enemy's strength is hard to measure. We ought first to pitch camp and send light cavalry to reconnoiter."
translations.idiomatic: Military Clerk Yan Shou remonstrated, "The road ahead is perilous and narrow, and the enemy's strength is hard to gauge. We ought to pitch camp first and send light cavalry to scout."

sentences.zh: 」顯意甚銳，怒，欲斬之，遂進兵。

translations.literal: " Xian's will was very keen. Angry, he wished to execute Shou and thereupon advanced the army.
translations.idiomatic: " Xian was eager to fight. In anger he wished to execute Shou and advanced anyway.

sentences.zh: 愚虜伏發，士窣窸走，唯授力戰，身被十創，手殺數人而死。

translations.literal: The foolish barbarians ambushed them. Soldiers fled in rustling disorder; only Shou fought with force. His body received ten wounds; by hand he killed several men and died.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians sprang an ambush. The troops broke and fled in disorder; only Shou fought on. He took ten wounds and killed several men with his own hands before he died.

sentences.zh: 主簿衛福、功曹徐鹹皆自投赴顯，俱歿於陳。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Wei Fu and Merit Officer Xu Xian all threw themselves forward toward Xian and together perished in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Wei Fu and Merit Officer Xu Xian both rushed to Xian's side and perished with him on the field.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以虎賁中郎將鄧騭為車騎將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Colonel of the Tiger Guards Deng Ni was made General of Cavalry and Chariots with protocol equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Colonel of the Tiger Guards Deng Ni was made General of Cavalry and Chariots with protocol equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.

sentences.zh: 騭弟黃門侍郎悝為虎賁中郎將，弘、閶皆侍中。

translations.literal: Ni's younger brother Gentleman-in-Attendance of the Yellow Gates Kui was made Colonel of the Tiger Guards; Hong and Chang were both Palace Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Ni's younger brother Gentleman-in-Attendance of the Yellow Gates Kui was made Colonel of the Tiger Guards; Hong and Chang were both made Palace Attendants.

sentences.zh: 司空陳寵薨。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Chen Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Chen Chong died.

sentences.zh: 五月，辛卯，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinmao, the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，河東垣山崩。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Mount Yuan in Hedong collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Mount Yuan in Hedong collapsed.

sentences.zh: 六月，丁未，以太常尹勤為司空。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingwei, the Grand Master of Splendid Horses Yin Qin was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei day, Grand Master of Splendid Horses Yin Qin was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 郡國三十七雨水。

translations.literal: Thirty-seven commanderies and kingdoms had rain disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-seven commanderies and kingdoms suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 己未，太后詔減太官、導官、尚方、內署諸服御、珍膳、靡麗難成之物，自非供陵廟，稻梁米不得導擇，朝夕一肉飯而已。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the empress dowager issued an edict to reduce the various garments, delicacies, and luxurious hard-to-make items of the Grand Steward, the Guiding Office, the Imperial Workshops, and the inner services. Except for supplying the imperial tombs and temples, rice and millet grain must not be specially selected—only one meat dish per meal morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the empress dowager ordered reductions in garments, delicacies, and costly luxuries from the Grand Steward, Guiding Office, Imperial Workshops, and inner services. Except for the imperial tombs and temples, grain was no longer specially selected; morning and evening there was only one meat dish per meal.

sentences.zh: 舊太官、湯官經用歲且二萬萬，自是裁數千萬。

translations.literal: Formerly the Grand Steward and Soup Office yearly used nearly two hundred million; from this it was trimmed to several tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Grand Steward and Soup Office spent nearly two hundred million a year; thereafter spending was cut to several tens of millions.

sentences.zh: 及郡國所貢，皆減其過半；

translations.literal: And tribute from commanderies and kingdoms—all was reduced by more than half;
translations.idiomatic: Tribute from the commanderies and kingdoms was cut by more than half;

sentences.zh: 悉斥賣上林鷹犬；

translations.literal: all were sold off—the Shanglin hawks and dogs;
translations.idiomatic: all the Shanglin hawks and dogs were sold off;

sentences.zh: 離宮、別館儲峙米□、薪炭，悉令省之。

translations.literal: retreat palaces and detached lodges stored rice□, firewood, and charcoal—all were ordered reduced.
translations.idiomatic: stored grain□, firewood, and charcoal at retreat palaces and detached lodges were all ordered cut back.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔免遣掖庭宮人及宗室沒入者皆為庶民。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict dismissed and sent away palace women of the Rear Palace and those of the imperial clan who had been confiscated—all were made common people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict released palace women of the Rear Palace and confiscated members of the imperial clan and made them commoners.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，庚寅，敕司隸校尉、部刺史曰：「間者郡國或有水災，防害秋稼，朝廷惟咎，憂惶悼懼。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day gengyin, she charged the Director of the Metropolitan Area and the provincial inspectors, saying, "Recently some commanderies and kingdoms have had flood disasters harming the autumn crops. The court blames itself alone, anxious, fearful, and grieved with dread."
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on gengyin day, she charged the Director of the Metropolitan Area and the provincial inspectors, "Recently some commanderies and kingdoms have suffered floods that harmed the autumn harvest. The court blames itself alone and is anxious with grief and dread."

sentences.zh: 而郡國欲獲豐穰虛飾之譽，遂覆蔽災害，多張墾田，不揣流亡，競增戶口，掩匿盜賊，令奸惡無懲，署用非次，選舉乖宜，貪苛慘毒，延及平民。

translations.literal: "Yet commanderies and kingdoms, wishing to gain the reputation of abundant harvests, then covered and concealed disasters, greatly inflated reclaimed fields, did not measure fugitives, competitively increased household registers, concealed robbers and bandits, let the wicked go unpunished, appointed officials out of order, made selections contrary to propriety, and were greedy, harsh, cruel, and poisonous, extending harm to common people."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet commanderies and kingdoms, seeking the reputation of abundance, covered up disasters, greatly inflated reclaimed fields, ignored fugitives, competed to swell household registers, concealed robbers, let the wicked go unpunished, appointed officials out of order, chose men improperly, and were greedy, harsh, and cruel even toward commoners."

sentences.zh: 刺史垂頭塞耳，阿私下比，不畏於天，不愧於人。

translations.literal: "Inspectors hung their heads and stopped their ears, fawning below and comparing with subordinates, not fearing Heaven and not ashamed before men."
translations.idiomatic: "Inspectors hung their heads and stopped their ears, fawning on subordinates, fearing neither Heaven nor shame before men."

sentences.zh: 假貸之恩，不可數恃，自今以後，將糾其罰。

translations.literal: "The favor of lenient loans cannot be repeatedly relied upon. From now on I shall correct them with punishment."
translations.idiomatic: "Lenient forbearance cannot be counted on again. From now on I shall correct them with punishment."

sentences.zh: 二千石長吏其各實核所傷害，為除田租芻稿。

translations.literal: "The two-thousand-dan chief officials should each truly verify the damage suffered and grant exemption from field rent and fodder."
translations.idiomatic: "Let each two-thousand-dan chief official truly verify the damage suffered and grant exemption from field rent and fodder."

sentences.zh: 八月，辛卯，帝崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinmao, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，殯於崇德前殿。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the coffin was placed at the front hall of Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the coffin was placed in the front hall of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 太后與兄車騎將軍騭、虎賁中郎將悝等定策禁中，其夜，使騭持節以王青蓋車迎清河王子祜，齋於殿中。

translations.literal: The empress dowager with her elder brother General of Cavalry and Chariots Ni, Colonel of the Tiger Guards Kui, and the rest fixed the succession within the forbidden precinct. That night she sent Ni bearing credentials with the king's blue-canopy carriage to welcome the son of the Prince of Qinghe, Hu, who fasted in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, with her elder brother General of Cavalry and Chariots Ni, Colonel of the Tiger Guards Kui, and the rest, fixed the succession inside the inner palace. That night she sent Ni with credentials in the king's blue-canopy carriage to welcome the Prince of Qinghe's son Hu, who fasted in the hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太后御崇德殿，百官皆吉服陪位，引拜祜為長安侯。

translations.literal: The empress dowager attended Chongde Hall. All officials in auspicious dress took their places. He was led in to bow to Hu as Marquis of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager presided in Chongde Hall. All officials in formal dress took their places, and Hu was led in and hailed as Marquis of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 乃下詔，以祜為孝和皇帝嗣，又作策命。

translations.literal: She then issued an edict making Hu heir of Emperor Xiaoh of Han, and also composed an appointment mandate.
translations.idiomatic: She then issued an edict making Hu heir to Emperor He of Han and composed an appointment mandate.

sentences.zh: 有司讀策畢，太尉奉上璽綬，即皇帝位，太后猶臨朝。

translations.literal: When the responsible officials finished reading the mandate, the Grand Commandant presented the seal and cord. He ascended the imperial throne, and the empress dowager still presided at court.
translations.idiomatic: When the responsible officials finished reading the mandate, the Grand Commandant presented the seal and cord. Hu took the throne, and the empress dowager still held court.

sentences.zh: 詔告司隸校尉、河南尹、南陽太守曰：「每覽前代，外戚賓客濁亂奉公，為民患苦，咎在執法怠懈，不輒行其罰故也。

translations.literal: An edict announced to the Director of the Metropolitan Area, the Intendant of Henan, and the Administrator of Nanyang, saying, "Whenever I read of past ages, empresses' kin and their guests muddied and disturbed public service and brought suffering to the people—the fault lay in law enforcement being lax and slow and not promptly carrying out punishment."
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Director of the Metropolitan Area, the Intendant of Henan, and the Administrator of Nanyang, "Whenever I read of past ages, empresses' kin and their guests corrupted public service and brought suffering on the people—the fault lay in lax enforcement that did not promptly punish them."

sentences.zh: 今車騎將軍騭等雖懷敬順之志，而宗門廣大，姻戚不少，賓客奸猾，多干禁憲，其明加檢敕，勿相容護。

translations.literal: "Now General of Cavalry and Chariots Ni and the rest, though bearing respectful and compliant intent, yet their clan gate is broad and marriage kin not few; guests are crafty and many violate forbidden laws. Clearly add inspection and discipline—do not tolerate or protect them."
translations.idiomatic: "Though General of Cavalry and Chariots Ni and his kin are respectful and compliant, their clan is large and their marriage kin many; their guests are crafty and often break the law. Inspect and discipline them clearly—do not tolerate or shield them."

sentences.zh: 」自是親屬犯罪，無所假貸。

translations.literal: " From this, when kin committed crimes, there was no lenient loan.
translations.idiomatic: " From then on, when kin committed crimes, none received lenience.

sentences.zh: 九月，六州大水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, six provinces had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month six provinces suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，葬孝殤皇帝於康陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Emperor Xiaoshang of Han was buried at Kangling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Emperor Shang of Han was buried at Kangling.

sentences.zh: 以連遭大憂，百姓苦役，方中秘藏及諸工作事，事減約十分居一。

translations.literal: Because of successive great bereavements and the people's suffering from corvée, matters of the inner imperial treasury and the various works were reduced to about one part in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm had suffered successive great bereavements and the people were worn down by corvée, work on the inner treasury and other projects was cut to about one-tenth.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，殞石於陳留。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, a meteorite fell in Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day a meteorite fell in Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 詔以北地梁慬為西域副校尉。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Liang Lin of Beidi as Deputy Colonel of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Liang Lin of Beidi Deputy Colonel of the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 慬行至河西，會西域諸國反，攻都護任尚於疏勒；

translations.literal: Lin, traveling, reached Hexi. It happened that the states of the Western Regions rebelled and attacked Protector Ren Shang at Shule;
translations.idiomatic: As Lin traveled he reached Hexi. The Western Region states rebelled and attacked Protector Ren Shang at Shule;

sentences.zh: 尚上書求救，詔慬將河西四郡羌，胡五千騎馳赴之。

translations.literal: Shang memorialized seeking rescue. An edict ordered Lin to lead five thousand Qiang and Hu cavalry from the four Hexi commanderies to hurry there.
translations.idiomatic: Shang memorialized for help. An edict ordered Lin to lead five thousand Qiang and Hu cavalry from the four Hexi commanderies to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 慬未至而尚己得解，詔征尚還，以騎都尉段禧為都護，西域長史趙博為騎都尉。

translations.literal: Before Lin arrived Shang was already relieved. An edict summoned Shang back, made Colonel of Cavalry Duan Xi protector, and made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions Zhao Bo Colonel of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Before Lin arrived Shang was already relieved. An edict recalled Shang, made Colonel of Cavalry Duan Xi protector, and made Western Regions Chief Clerk Zhao Bo Colonel of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 禧、博守它乾城，城小，梁慬以為不可固，乃譎說龜茲王白霸，欲入共保其城；

translations.literal: Xi and Bo guarded Taqian city. The city was small. Liang Lin thought it could not be held firm and thereupon deceitfully persuaded King Bai Ba of Kucha, wishing to enter and jointly guard his city;
translations.idiomatic: Xi and Bo held Taqian, a small city. Liang Lin thought it could not be held and deceitfully persuaded King Bai Ba of Kucha to let them enter and guard his city together;

sentences.zh: 白霸許之，吏民固諫，白霸不聽。

translations.literal: Bai Ba agreed. Officials and people firmly remonstrated, but Bai Ba would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Ba agreed. Officials and commoners remonstrated firmly, but he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 慬既入，遣將急迎段禧、趙博，合軍八九千人。

translations.literal: After Lin had entered, he sent a general urgently to welcome Duan Xi and Zhao Bo. Combined, the army was eight or nine thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Once Lin had entered, he sent a general in haste to bring in Duan Xi and Zhao Bo. Together they mustered eight or nine thousand men.

sentences.zh: 龜茲吏民並叛其王，而與溫宿、姑墨數萬兵反，共圍城，慬等出戰，大破之。

translations.literal: Kucha's officials and people all rebelled against their king and, with Wensu and Gumo, tens of thousands of troops in revolt, jointly besieged the city. Lin and the rest went out to battle and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha's officials and people rebelled against their king and, with Wensu and Gumo, raised tens of thousands of men in revolt and besieged the city. Lin and his men sallied forth and routed them.

sentences.zh: 連兵數月，胡眾敗走，乘勝追擊，凡斬首萬餘級，獲生口數千人，龜茲乃定。

translations.literal: Battling for several months, the Hu masses were defeated and fled. Taking victory, they pursued. In all they beheaded more than ten thousand heads and captured several thousand living. Kucha was then stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: After months of fighting the Hu forces broke and fled. Pursuing in victory, they took more than ten thousand heads and several thousand captives. Kucha was then pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，四州大水，雨雹。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, four provinces had great floods and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, four provinces suffered great floods and hail.

sentences.zh: 清河孝王慶病篤，上書求葬樊濯宋貴人塚旁。

translations.literal: Prince Xiao of Qinghe was critically ill and submitted a memorial asking to be buried beside the tombs of the Honored Ladies Fan Zhuo and Song.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao of Qinghe was gravely ill and memorialized asking to be buried beside the tombs of the Honored Ladies Fan Zhuo and Song.

sentences.zh: 十二月，甲子，王薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, the prince died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi day, the prince died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷魚龍曼延戲。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the fish-dragon spreading performance was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the fish-dragon pageant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 尚書郎南陽樊准以儒風浸衰，上疏曰：「臣聞人君不可以不學。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhun of Nanyang, seeing Confucian style gradually declining, submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant has heard that a human ruler cannot but study."
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhun of Nanyang, seeing Confucian learning in decline, memorialized, "I have heard that a ruler cannot do without study."

sentences.zh: 光武皇帝受命中興，東西誅戰，不遑啟處，然猶投戈講藝，息馬論道。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu received the mandate and restored the dynasty, campaigning east and west without leisure to settle, yet still cast aside weapons to discuss the arts and rested horses to discourse on the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu received the mandate and restored the dynasty. Though he campaigned east and west without leisure to rest, he still cast aside weapons to discuss the arts and rested his horses to discourse on the Way.

sentences.zh: 孝明皇帝庶政萬機，無不簡心，而垂情古典，游意經藝，每饗射禮畢，正坐自講，諸儒並聽，四方欣欣。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaoming—myriad affairs of government, none not attended by his heart—yet also cherished classical antiquity and roamed in the classics. Each time when the archery feast ritual finished, he sat upright and lectured himself while all the scholars listened together, and the four quarters rejoiced gladly.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming handled the myriad affairs of state, none neglected, yet still cherished the classics and dwelt in the canon. When each archery feast ended he sat upright and lectured while all the scholars listened, and the four quarters rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 又多征名儒，布在廓廟，每宴會則論難衎衎，共求政化，期門、羽林介冑之士，悉通《孝經》，化自聖躬，流及蠻荒，是以議者每稱盛時，鹹言永平。

translations.literal: He also summoned many famous Confucians and spread them through the outer court. At each feast they debated with lively eloquence and jointly sought governance and transformation. Guards of the Gate and Feathered Forest men in armor all mastered the Classic of Filial Piety. Transformation came from the sacred person and flowed to the barbarian wilds. Therefore deliberators each praised the flourishing age and all spoke of Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: He also summoned many famous scholars and placed them in the outer court. At each feast they debated with lively eloquence and sought good government together. Guards of the Gate and armored men of the Feathered Forest all mastered the Classic of Filial Piety. Transformation began with the sovereign and reached even the wild borderlands, so deliberators praised that flourishing age and all called it the Yongping era.

sentences.zh: 今學者益少，遠方尤甚，博士倚席不講，儒者競論浮麗，忘謇謇之忠，習諓諓之辭，臣愚以為宜下明詔，博求幽隱，寵進儒雅，以俟聖上講習之期。

translations.literal: Now scholars are ever fewer, distant regions especially so. Erudites lean on their mats without lecturing. Confucians compete in discussing floating elegance, forgetting forthright loyal speech and learning flattering words. Your servant foolishly thinks one ought to issue a bright edict, broadly seek the hidden and reclusive, favor and advance elegant Confucians, to await the sacred sovereign's time for lecture and study.
translations.idiomatic: Now scholars grow ever fewer, especially in distant regions. Erudites lean on their mats without teaching. Confucians compete in empty elegance, forgetting forthright loyalty and learning flattery. I foolishly think Your Majesty should issue a clear edict, seek the hidden and reclusive broadly, favor true scholars, and await the day when the sovereign may lecture and study again.

sentences.zh: 」太后深納其言，詔：「公、卿、中二千石各舉隱士、大儒，務取高行，以勸後進，妙簡博士，必得其人。

translations.literal: " The empress dowager deeply accepted his words and issued an edict: "Ducal ministers and two-thousand-dan officials should each recommend hidden scholars and great Confucians, striving to obtain high conduct to encourage those coming after, and finely select erudites—you must obtain the right men."
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager deeply accepted his counsel and ordered, "Let each ducal minister and two-thousand-dan official recommend hidden scholars and great Confucians, seeking high conduct to encourage those who follow, and choose erudites with care—you must obtain worthy men."

sentences.zh: 漢孝安皇帝上

translations.literal: Han Emperor Xiao An, Part One.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An of Han, Part One.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，癸酉朔，赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the new moon of the day guiyou, the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the new moon of guiyou day, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 蜀郡徼外羌內屬。

translations.literal: Qiang beyond the frontier of Shu Commandery submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang beyond the Shu frontier submitted.

sentences.zh: 二月，丁卯，分清河國封帝弟常保為廣川王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingmao, Qinghe state was divided and the emperor's younger brother Changbao was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao day, Qinghe was divided and the emperor's younger brother Changbao was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，司徒梁鮪薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Minister of Education Liang Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Minister of Education Liang Jin died.

sentences.zh: 三月，癸酉，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiyou, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，永昌徼外僬僥種夷陸類等舉種內附。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Jiaorao tribal Yi Lu Lei and the rest beyond the frontier of Yongchang led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Jiaorao Yi Lu Lei and others beyond the Yongchang frontier led their tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬清河孝王於廣丘，司空、宗正護喪事，儀比東海恭王。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Prince Xiao of Qinghe was buried at Guangqiu. The Minister of Works and Director of the Imperial Clan oversaw the funeral rites, with protocol equal to Prince Gong of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince Xiao of Qinghe was buried at Guangqiu. The Minister of Works and Director of the Imperial Clan oversaw the funeral with rites equal to those for Prince Gong of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 自和帝之喪，鄧騭兄弟常居禁中，騭不欲久在內，連求還第，太后許之。

translations.literal: From Emperor He's funeral, the Deng Ni brothers had constantly dwelt within the forbidden precinct. Ni did not wish to remain long inside and repeatedly asked to return to his residence. The empress dowager permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Since Emperor He's funeral the Deng Ni brothers had lived inside the inner palace. Ni did not wish to stay there long and repeatedly asked to return home. The empress dowager granted it.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，封太傅張禹、太尉徐防、司空尹勤、車騎將軍鄧騭，城門校尉鄧悝、虎賁中郎將鄧弘、黃門郎鄧閶皆為列侯，食邑各萬戶，騭以定策功增三千戶；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Grand Tutor Zhang Yu, Grand Commandant Xu Fang, Minister of Works Yin Qin, General of Cavalry and Chariots Deng Ni, Colonel of the City Gates Deng Kui, Colonel of the Tiger Guards Deng Hong, and Gentleman of the Yellow Gates Deng Chang were all enfeoffed as ranked marquises with fiefs of ten thousand households each. Ni, for merit in fixing the succession, received an additional three thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Grand Tutor Zhang Yu, Grand Commandant Xu Fang, Minister of Works Yin Qin, General of Cavalry and Chariots Deng Ni, Colonel of the City Gates Kui, Colonel of the Tiger Guards Hong, and Gentleman of the Yellow Gates Chang were all enfeoffed as ranked marquises with ten-thousand-household fiefs. For fixing the succession Ni received three thousand households more;

sentences.zh: 騭及諸弟辭讓不獲，遂逃避使者，間關詣闕，上疏自陳，至於五六，乃許之。

translations.literal: Ni and his various younger brothers declined and could not succeed. They thereupon fled from the envoys, reaching the palace by hard paths, submitted memorials stating their case—up to five or six times—before it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ni and his brothers declined but could not refuse. They fled the envoys, made their way to the palace by hard paths, and memorialized their case five or six times before permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 五月，甲戌，以長樂衛尉魯恭為司徒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiaxu, Chamberlain for the Palace of Eternal Joy Lu Gong was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiaxu day, Chamberlain for the Palace of Eternal Joy Lu Gong was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 恭上言：「舊制，立秋乃行薄刑，自永元十五年以來，改用孟夏。

translations.literal: Gong submitted, saying, "By old regulation, lenient punishments were carried out only at the Beginning of Autumn. Since the fifteenth year of Yongyuan, the Beginning of Summer has been used instead."
translations.idiomatic: Gong memorialized, "By old regulation lenient punishments were carried out only at the Beginning of Autumn. Since the fifteenth year of Yongyuan the Beginning of Summer has been used instead."

sentences.zh: 而刺史、太守因以盛夏徵召農民，拘對考驗，連滯無已。

translations.literal: "Yet inspectors and governors thereupon, in the height of summer, summoned farmers, detained them for examination and verification, and delays dragged on without end."
translations.idiomatic: "Inspectors and governors thereupon summon farmers in the height of summer, detain them for examination, and delays drag on without end."

sentences.zh: 上逆時氣，下傷農業。

translations.literal: "Above, this goes against the season's qi; below, it harms agriculture."
translations.idiomatic: "Above it goes against the season; below it harms the harvest."

sentences.zh: 按月令『孟夏斷薄刑』者，謂其輕罪已正，不欲令久系，故時斷之也。

translations.literal: "According to the monthly ordinances, 'At the Beginning of Summer suspend lenient punishments' means that when light crimes have already been corrected, one does not wish them long imprisoned, and therefore suspends them at that season."
translations.idiomatic: "The monthly ordinances say 'At the Beginning of Summer suspend lenient punishments' because once light crimes are settled one does not wish prisoners held long, and therefore releases them at that season."

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為今孟夏之制，可從此令。

translations.literal: "Your servant foolishly thinks the present Beginning-of-Summer regulation may follow this ordinance."
translations.idiomatic: "I foolishly think the present Beginning-of-Summer practice should follow this ordinance."

sentences.zh: 其決獄案考，皆以立秋為斷。

translations.literal: "Deciding cases and conducting examinations in prison should all take the Beginning of Autumn as their limit."
translations.idiomatic: "Deciding cases and conducting prison examinations should all end at the Beginning of Autumn."

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「孝章皇帝欲助三正之微，定律著令，斷獄皆以冬至之前。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Emperor Xiaozhang wished to aid the slightness of the three beginnings, fixed laws and issued ordinances, and decided cases all before the winter solstice."
translations.idiomatic: " He also memorialized, "Emperor Zhang wished to aid the slightness of the three beginnings, fixed laws and ordinances, and required that cases be decided before the winter solstice."

sentences.zh: 小吏不與國同心者，率入十一月得死罪賊，不問曲直，便即格殺，雖有疑罪，不復讞正。

translations.literal: "Petty clerks not of one heart with the state, as a rule in the eleventh month, when they obtained capital criminals or bandits, asked neither right nor wrong and at once killed them on the spot. Even when there was doubtful guilt, they no longer submitted for deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: "Petty clerks not loyal to the state, as a rule in the eleventh month, when they caught capital criminals or bandits, asked neither right nor wrong and killed them on the spot. Even doubtful cases were no longer sent up for review."

sentences.zh: 可令大辟之科，盡冬月乃斷。

translations.literal: "One may order that capital cases all be decided only in the winter months."
translations.idiomatic: "Let capital cases be decided only in the winter months."

sentences.zh: 」朝廷皆從之。

translations.literal: " The court all followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The court accepted all of this.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔封北海王睦孫壽光侯普為北海王。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict enfeoffed Marquis of Shouguang Pu, grandson of Prince Mu of Beihai, as Prince of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict made Marquis of Shouguang Pu, grandson of Prince Mu of Beihai, Prince of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 九真徼外、夜郎蠻夷，舉土內屬。

translations.literal: Beyond the frontier of Jiuzhen and the barbarian Yi of Yelang—all their lands submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Jiuzhen frontier and among the Yelang tribes, whole territories submitted.

sentences.zh: 西域都護段禧等雖保龜茲，而道路隔塞，檄書不通。

translations.literal: Protector of the Western Regions Duan Xi and the rest, though they preserved Kucha, yet the roads were blocked and sealed and dispatch documents could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: Protector Duan Xi and his men, though they held Kucha, were cut off on the roads and dispatches could not get through.

sentences.zh: 公卿議者以為「西域阻遠，數有背叛，吏士屯田。

translations.literal: Those among the ducal ministers who deliberated held that "the Western Regions are obstructed and distant, repeatedly rebellious, and officials and soldiers garrison and farm the land.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberators among the ducal ministers held that "the Western Regions are distant and obstructed, rebel repeatedly, and officials and soldiers must farm garrisons there.

sentences.zh: 其費無已。

translations.literal: "The expense has no end."
translations.idiomatic: "The expense never ends."

sentences.zh: 」六月，壬戌，罷西域都護，遣騎都尉王弘發關中兵，迎禧及梁慬、趙博、伊吾盧、柳中屯田吏士而還。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, on the day renxu, the Protector of the Western Regions was abolished. Colonel of Cavalry Wang Hong was sent to muster Guanzhong troops and welcome back Xi, Liang Lin, Zhao Bo, and the officials and soldiers farming garrisons at Yiwulu and Liuzhong.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month, on renxu day, the Protector of the Western Regions was abolished. Colonel of Cavalry Wang Hong was sent to muster Guanzhong troops and bring back Xi, Liang Lin, Zhao Bo, and the garrison farmers of Yiwulu and Liuzhong.

sentences.zh: 初，燒當羌豪東號之子麻奴隨父來降，居於安定。

translations.literal: Earlier, Manu, son of the Shaodang Qiang chieftain Eastern Hao, followed his father in submission and dwelt in Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Manu, son of the Shaodang Qiang chieftain Eastern Hao, had followed his father in submission and lived in Anding.

sentences.zh: 時諸降羌布在郡縣，皆為吏民豪右所徭役，積以愁怨。

translations.literal: At this time the various submitted Qiang were spread through commanderies and counties and all were pressed into corvée by powerful local officials and gentry. Bitterness and resentment accumulated.
translations.idiomatic: At that time submitted Qiang were spread through the commanderies and counties and were all pressed into corvée by local officials and powerful families, and resentment built over time.

sentences.zh: 及王弘西迎段禧，發金城、隴西、漢陽羌數百千騎與俱，郡縣迫促發遣。

translations.literal: When Wang Hong went west to welcome Duan Xi, he mustered several hundred or thousand Qiang horsemen from Jincheng, Longxi, and Hanyang to go with him, and commanderies and counties pressed urgently to dispatch them.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Hong went west to fetch Duan Xi, he mustered several hundred or thousand Qiang horsemen from Jincheng, Longxi, and Hanyang to accompany him, and the commanderies and counties pressed urgently to dispatch them.

sentences.zh: 群羌懼遠屯不還，行到酒泉，頗有散叛，諸郡各發兵邀遮，或覆其廬落；

translations.literal: The mass of Qiang feared distant encampment and not returning; reaching Jiuquan, many scattered and rebelled, and the various commanderies each sent troops to intercept and block, some overturning their camps;
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang masses feared the distant garrison would never let them return. Reaching Jiuquan, many scattered and rebelled. The commanderies each sent troops to intercept them, and some overran their camps;

sentences.zh: 於是勒姐、當煎大豪東岸等愈驚，遂同時奔潰。

translations.literal: thereupon the great chiefs of Lejie and Dangjian, Dong'an and others, grew ever more alarmed and thereupon fled and collapsed together.
translations.idiomatic: thereupon the great chiefs of Lejie and Dangjian, including Dong'an, grew ever more alarmed and fled and collapsed together.

sentences.zh: 麻奴兄弟因此與種人俱西出塞，先零別種，滇零與鍾羌諸種大為寇掠，斷隴道。

translations.literal: Manu and his brothers on this account with the tribesmen all went west beyond the pass; the separate branch of Xianling, Dianling and the various Zhong Qiang tribes greatly raided and plundered, cutting the Long Road.
translations.idiomatic: Manu and his brothers thereupon went west beyond the pass with their tribesmen. The separate Xianling branch, Dianling, and the various Zhong Qiang tribes raided on a great scale and cut the Long Road.

sentences.zh: 時羌歸附既久，無復器甲，或持竹竿木枝以代戈矛，或負板案以為楯，或執銅鏡以象兵，郡縣畏懦不能制，丁卯，赦除諸羌相連結謀叛逆者罪。

translations.literal: At this time the Qiang had long submitted and had no arms or armor again; some held bamboo poles and wooden branches in place of spears and halberds, some bore boards and trays as shields, some grasped bronze mirrors to represent troops—the commanderies and counties were fearful and weak and could not control them. On dingmao day, an amnesty removed the crime of all Qiang who had joined in plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang had long been submitted and had no arms or armor. Some held bamboo poles and wooden branches instead of spears and halberds, some bore boards and trays as shields, and some grasped bronze mirrors to imitate soldiers. The commanderies and counties were fearful and could not control them. On dingmao day, an amnesty removed the crime of Qiang who had joined in plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 秋，九月，午，太尉徐防以災異，寇賊策免。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on the day wu, Grand Commandant Xu Fang was dismissed by memorial on account of calamities and strange events and bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the ninth month, on wu day, Grand Commandant Xu Fang was dismissed by memorial on account of calamities and banditry.

sentences.zh: 三公以災異免，自防始。

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies were dismissed on account of calamities and strange events—beginning with Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissal of the Three Excellencies on account of calamities began with Fang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，司空尹勤以水雨漂流策免。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Minister of Works Yin Qin was dismissed by memorial on account of flooding and drifting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Minister of Works Yin Qin was dismissed by memorial on account of flooding.

sentences.zh: ══仲長統昌言曰：光武皇帝慍數世之失權，忿強臣之竊命，矯枉過直，政不任下，雖置三公，事歸台閣。

translations.literal: ══ Zhongchang Tong's Changyan says: Emperor Guangwu resented several generations' loss of power and was angry that powerful ministers stole the mandate; correcting the crooked he went past straight—government did not entrust the lower ranks; though he set up the Three Excellencies, affairs returned to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: ══ Zhongchang Tong's Changyan says: Emperor Guangwu resented generations of lost power and was angry that powerful ministers stole the mandate. In correcting the crooked he went past straight—government did not entrust subordinates. Though he set up the Three Excellencies, affairs returned to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 自此以來，三公之職，備員而已；

translations.literal: From this time onward, the office of the Three Excellencies was filling posts only;
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward, the Three Excellencies were mere figureheads;

sentences.zh: 然政有不治，猶加譴責。

translations.literal: yet when government was not well ordered, blame and censure were still added.
translations.idiomatic: yet when government went awry, they were still blamed and censured.

sentences.zh: 而權移外戚之家，寵被近習之豎，親其黨類，用其私人，內充京師，外布列郡，顛倒賢愚，貿易選舉，疲駑守境，貪殘牧民，撓擾百姓，忿怒四夷，招致乖叛，亂離斯瘼，怨氣並作，陰陽失和，三光虧缺，怪異數至，蟲螟食稼，水旱為災。

translations.literal: Yet power shifted to empresses' kin households, favor reached the eunuchs of close attendance; they favored their factions and employed their private men, filling the capital within and spreading through the commanderies without, inverting worthy and foolish, trading in selections and appointments, keeping worn nags to guard the borders, being greedy and cruel in shepherding the people, harassing the common folk, enraging the four barbarians, inviting estrangement and rebellion, disorder and separation becoming this affliction, resentful qi arising together, yin and yang losing harmony, the three luminaries deficient and broken, strange things arriving repeatedly, insects and locusts eating the crops, flood and drought becoming calamities.
translations.idiomatic: Yet power shifted to empresses' kin, favor reached the eunuchs of close attendance. They favored their factions and employed their private men, filling the capital within and spreading through the commanderies without, inverting worthy and foolish and trading in appointments, keeping worn nags to guard the borders and being greedy and cruel toward the people, harassing the common folk and enraging the four barbarians, inviting estrangement and rebellion. Disorder and separation became this affliction. Resentment arose together, yin and yang lost harmony, the sun, moon, and stars were dimmed, strange things came repeatedly, insects and locusts ate the crops, and flood and drought brought calamity.

sentences.zh: 此皆戚宦之臣所致然也，反以策讓三公，至於死、免，乃足為叫呼蒼天，號咷泣血者矣！

translations.literal: All this was brought about by ministers who were empresses' kin and eunuchs, yet in reverse they used memorials to shift blame onto the Three Excellencies—reaching death and dismissal—enough to make one cry out to azure Heaven and wail until blood flowed from weeping!
translations.idiomatic: All this was wrought by empresses' kin and eunuch ministers, yet memorials shifted the blame onto the Three Excellencies until death and dismissal—enough to make one cry out to Heaven and wail until blood flowed!

sentences.zh: 又，中世之選三公也，務於清愨謹慎，循常習故者，是乃婦女之檢柙，鄉曲之常人耳，惡足以居斯位邪！

translations.literal: Moreover, in selecting the Three Excellencies in the middle age, they strove for purity, honesty, and caution—those who followed routine and old custom were but a woman's restraints and a village's ordinary man—how could they suffice to hold these posts!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, middle-period selection of the Three Excellencies strove for purity, honesty, and caution. Men who followed routine and old custom were but a woman's restraints and a village ordinary—how could they suffice for these posts!

sentences.zh: 勢既如彼，選又如此，而慾望三公勳立於國家，績加於生民，不亦遠乎！

translations.literal: The power situation being already like that, selection being again like this—yet to desire that the Three Excellencies establish merit for the state and add achievement for the living people—is that not far indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Power being already like that and selection again like this, yet to expect the Three Excellencies to establish merit for the state and benefit the people—is that not far indeed!

sentences.zh: 昔文帝之於鄧通，可謂至愛，而猶展申徒嘉之志。

translations.literal: Of old Emperor Wen toward Deng Tong could be called utmost love, yet he still extended Shen Tujia's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Of old Emperor Wen's love for Deng Tong could be called utmost, yet he still carried out Shen Tujia's intent.

sentences.zh: 夫見任如此，則何患於左右小臣哉！

translations.literal: If one seen and entrusted were like this, what worry would there be for petty ministers at one's side!
translations.idiomatic: If those seen and entrusted were like this, what worry would there be for petty ministers at one's side!

sentences.zh: 至如近世，外戚、宦豎，請托不行，意氣不滿，立能陷人於不測之禍，惡可得彈正者哉！

translations.literal: As for recent times, empresses' kin and eunuch attendants—if requests and entrustments were not carried out, if their spirit was not satisfied, they could at once trap a man in unforeseen calamity—how could they be impeached and corrected!
translations.idiomatic: As for recent times, if empresses' kin and eunuch attendants found requests denied or their pride unsatisfied, they could at once trap a man in unforeseen calamity. How could they be impeached and corrected!

sentences.zh: 曩者任之重而責之輕，今者任之輕而責之重。

translations.literal: Formerly responsibility was heavy and blame light; now responsibility is light and blame heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly responsibility was heavy and blame light; now responsibility is light and blame heavy.

sentences.zh: 光武奪三公之重，至今而加甚；

translations.literal: Guangwu stripped the Three Excellencies of weight, and to the present it has grown ever more severe;
translations.idiomatic: Guangwu stripped the Three Excellencies of weight, and to the present it has grown ever more severe;

sentences.zh: 不假後黨以權，數世而不行；

translations.literal: he did not lend power to empresses' kin of later ages—several generations and it was not done;
translations.idiomatic: he did not lend power to empresses' kin of later ages—several generations passed and it was not done;

sentences.zh: 蓋親疏之勢異也！

translations.literal: surely because the situation of near and distant kin differed!
translations.idiomatic: surely because the situation of near and distant kin differed!

sentences.zh: 今人主誠專委三公，分任責成，而在位病民，舉用失賢，百姓不安，爭訟不息，天地多變，人物多妖，然後可以分此罪矣！

translations.literal: Now if the ruler truly specially entrusted the Three Excellencies, divided duties and charged them with completion, yet those in office harmed the people, promotions and employment lost the worthy, the common folk were not at peace, lawsuits did not cease, Heaven and Earth had many changes, and men and things had many portents—only then could this guilt be apportioned!
translations.idiomatic: Now if the ruler truly entrusted the Three Excellencies, divided duties, and charged them with results, yet those in office harmed the people, promotions lost the worthy, the common folk were unrestful, lawsuits did not cease, Heaven and Earth changed often, and portents multiplied among men and things—only then could this guilt be apportioned!

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔：太僕、少府減黃門鼓吹以補羽林士；

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict: the Grand Coachman and Privy Treasurer were to reduce Yellow Gate musicians to supplement Forest Army gentlemen;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, an edict ordered the Grand Coachman and Privy Treasurer to reduce Yellow Gate musicians to supplement Gentlemen of the Forest Army;

sentences.zh: 廄馬非乘輿常所御者，皆減半食；

translations.literal: stable horses not regularly ridden by the imperial carriage were all to have half rations;
translations.idiomatic: stable horses not regularly used by the imperial carriage were all to receive half rations;

sentences.zh: 諸所造作，非供宗廟園陵之用，皆且止。

translations.literal: all constructions not for supplying the ancestral temples and park tombs were for the time to cease.
translations.idiomatic: all construction not for the ancestral temples and park tombs was for the time to cease.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以太傅張禹為太尉，太常周章為司空。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Grand Tutor Zhang Yu was made Grand Commandant, and Grand Master of Ceremonies Zhou Zhang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Grand Tutor Zhang Yu was made Grand Commandant and Grand Master of Ceremonies Zhou Zhang was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 大長秋鄭眾、中常侍蔡倫等皆秉勢豫政，周章數進直言，太后不能用。

translations.literal: Grand Chamberlain for the Palace Zheng Zhong, Regular Palace Attendant Cai Lun, and others all grasped power and took part in government; Zhou Zhang repeatedly advanced straight words—the empress dowager could not employ them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chamberlain for the Palace Zheng Zhong, Regular Palace Attendant Cai Lun, and others all grasped power and took part in government. Zhou Zhang repeatedly spoke plainly, but the empress dowager would not heed him.

sentences.zh: 初，太后以平原王勝有痼疾，而貪殤帝孩抱，養為己子，故立焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, the empress dowager because Prince Sheng of Pingyuan had a chronic ailment yet coveted the infant Emperor Shang in his arms, reared him as her own son, and therefore established him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the empress dowager, because Prince Sheng of Pingyuan had a chronic ailment yet coveted the infant Emperor Shang in his arms, reared him as her own son and therefore established him.

sentences.zh: 及殤帝崩，群臣以勝疾非痼，意鹹歸之；

translations.literal: When Emperor Shang died, the ministers because Sheng's illness was not chronic, their minds all turned to him;
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shang died, the ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and all inclined toward him;

sentences.zh: 太后以前不立勝，恐後為怨，乃迎帝而立之。

translations.literal: the empress dowager because she had earlier not established Sheng, feared he would later bear resentment, and thereupon welcomed the emperor and established him.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager, fearing resentment because she had earlier not established Sheng, welcomed the emperor and established him.

sentences.zh: 周章以眾心不附，密謀閉宮門，誅鄧騭兄弟及鄭眾、蔡倫，劫尚書，廢太后於南宮，封帝為遠國王而立平原王。

translations.literal: Zhou Zhang because popular hearts did not attach, secretly plotted to close the palace gates, execute the Deng Zhi brothers and Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, enfeoff the emperor as king of a distant state, and establish the Prince of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zhang, because popular hearts did not attach, secretly plotted to close the palace gates, execute the Deng Zhi brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, enfeoff the emperor as king of a distant state, and establish the Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 事覺，冬，十一月，丁亥，章自殺。

translations.literal: The affair was discovered. In winter, the eleventh month, on dinghai day, Zhang killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: The affair was discovered. In winter, in the eleventh month, on dinghai day, Zhang killed himself.

sentences.zh: 戊子，敕司隸校尉、冀、并二州刺史，「民訛言相驚，棄捐舊居，老弱相攜，窮困道路。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, he charged the Director of Retainers, and the inspectors of Ji and Bing, "The people, alarmed by false rumors, abandoned their old dwellings; old and weak led one another, destitute on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, he charged the Director of Retainers and the inspectors of Ji and Bing, "The people, alarmed by false rumors, abandoned their old dwellings. Old and weak led one another, destitute on the roads."

sentences.zh: 其各敕所部長吏躬親曉喻：若欲歸本郡，在所為封長檄；

translations.literal: Each is to charge the chief officials of his jurisdiction to go in person and instruct clearly: if they wish to return to their native commandery, where they are let them seal a long dispatch;
translations.idiomatic: Each is to charge his chief officials to go in person and instruct them clearly: if they wish to return to their native commandery, let them seal a long dispatch where they are;"

sentences.zh: 不欲，勿強。

translations.literal: if they do not wish to, do not compel."
translations.idiomatic: if they do not wish to, do not compel them."

sentences.zh: 十二月，乙卯，以穎川太守張敏為司空。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Administrator of Yingchuan Zhang Min was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Administrator of Yingchuan Zhang Min was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 詔車騎將軍鄧騭、征西校尉任尚將五營及諸郡兵五萬人，屯漢陽以備羌。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General of Chariots and Cavalry Deng Zhi and Colonel of the Western Expedition Ren Shang to lead the Five Camps and commandery troops, fifty thousand men, to encamp at Hanyang to guard against the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered General of Chariots and Cavalry Deng Zhi and Colonel of the Western Expedition Ren Shang to lead the Five Camps and commandery troops, fifty thousand men, to encamp at Hanyang against the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國十八地震，四十一大水，二十八大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: This year, eighteen commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes, forty-one great floods, twenty-eight great winds, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: This year eighteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes, forty-one suffered great floods, twenty-eight suffered great winds, and there was hail.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑大人燕荔陽詣闕朝賀。

translations.literal: The Xianbei great chief Yanliyang came to the court to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei great chief Yanliyang came to court to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 太后賜燕荔陽王印綬、赤車、參駕，令止烏桓校尉所居寧城下，通胡市，因築南、北兩部質館。

translations.literal: The empress dowager granted Yanliyang king's seal and cord, a red carriage, and three-horse equipage, ordered him to stop below Ningcheng where the Wuhuan Colonel dwelt, open markets with the Hu, and thereupon built hostage lodges for the southern and northern divisions.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager granted Yanliyang a king's seal and cord, a red carriage, and three-horse equipage, ordered him to stay below Ningcheng where the Wuhuan Colonel dwelt, open markets with the Hu, and built hostage lodges for the southern and northern divisions.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑邑落百二十部各遺入質。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty Xianbei settlements and tribes each sent hostages in.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty Xianbei settlements and tribes each sent in hostages.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，鄧騭至漢陽；

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Deng Zhi reached Hanyang;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, Deng Zhi reached Hanyang;

sentences.zh: 諸郡兵未至，鐘羌數千人擊敗騭軍於冀西，殺千餘人。

translations.literal: the commandery troops had not arrived; several thousand Zhong Qiang defeated Zhi's army in Jixi, killing more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: the commandery troops had not arrived. Several thousand Zhong Qiang defeated Zhi's army in Jixi and killed more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 梁慬還，至敦煌，逆詔慬留為諸軍援。

translations.literal: Liang Xi was returning and reached Dunhuang; contrary to the edict, Xi was kept as reinforcement for the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xi was returning and reached Dunhuang. Contrary to the edict, Xi was kept as reinforcement for the armies.

sentences.zh: 慬至張掖，破諸羌萬餘人，其能脫者十二三；

translations.literal: Xi reached Zhangye and broke more than ten thousand of the various Qiang; those who could escape were one or two in ten;
translations.idiomatic: Xi reached Zhangye and routed more than ten thousand of the various Qiang. Only one or two in ten escaped;

sentences.zh: 進至姑臧，羌大豪三百餘人詣慬降，並慰譬，遣還故地。

translations.literal: advancing to Guzang, more than three hundred great Qiang chiefs came to Xi to submit; he comforted and instructed them all and sent them back to their former lands.
translations.idiomatic: advancing to Guzang, more than three hundred great Qiang chiefs came to submit to Xi. He comforted and instructed them all and sent them back to their former lands.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞樊准以郡國連年水旱，民多饑困，上疏：「請令太官、尚方、考功、上林池御諸官，實減無事之物；

translations.literal: Imperial Secretary Fan Zhun because commanderies and kingdoms for successive years had flood and drought and the people were largely hungry and distressed, submitted a memorial: "Request that the Grand Provisioner, Palace Workshop, Office for Evaluating Merit, Shanglin Park, Ponds and Parks, and the various offices truly reduce idle items;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Secretary Fan Zhun, because commanderies and kingdoms had suffered flood and drought for successive years and the people were largely hungry and distressed, submitted a memorial: "Request that the Grand Provisioner, Palace Workshop, Office for Evaluating Merit, Shanglin Park, Ponds and Parks, and the various offices truly reduce idle items;"

sentences.zh: 五府調省中都官吏、京師作者。

translations.literal: the Five Offices adjust and reduce capital officials and capital construction workers.
translations.idiomatic: the Five Offices adjust and reduce capital officials and capital construction workers."

sentences.zh: 又，被災之郡，百姓凋殘，恐非賑給所能勝贍，雖有其名，終無其實。

translations.literal: Moreover, in disaster-struck commanderies the people were withered and ruined—fearing that relief and grants could not suffice to support them; though the name existed, in the end there was no substance.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in disaster-struck commanderies the people were withered and ruined. I fear relief and grants cannot suffice to support them; though the name exists, in the end there is no substance."

sentences.zh: 可依征和元年故事，遣使持節慰安，尤困乏者徙置荊、揚孰郡。

translations.literal: One may follow the precedent of the first year of Zhenghe, send envoys holding credentials to comfort and reassure, and for those especially destitute relocate them to fertile commanderies of Jing and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: One may follow the precedent of the first year of Zhenghe, send envoys holding credentials to comfort and reassure, and relocate those especially destitute to fertile commanderies of Jing and Yang."

sentences.zh: 今雖有西屯之役，宜先東州之急。

translations.literal: Now though there is the western encampment campaign, the eastern provinces' urgency ought to come first.
translations.idiomatic: Now though there is the western encampment campaign, the eastern provinces' urgency ought to come first."

sentences.zh: 」太后從之。

translations.literal: " The empress dowager followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager followed this.

sentences.zh: 悉以公田賦與貧民，即擢准與議郎呂倉並守光祿大夫。

translations.literal: All public fields were assigned and given to the poor; Zhun and Gentleman Consultant Lü Cang were at once promoted to act as Household Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: All public fields were assigned to the poor. Zhun and Gentleman Consultant Lü Cang were at once promoted to act as Household Ministers.

sentences.zh: 二月，乙丑，遺准使冀州、倉使兗州稟貸，流民鹹得蘇息。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yichou day, Zhun was sent as envoy to Ji Province and Cang to Yan Province to distribute loans; the displaced people all obtained relief and revival.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou day, Zhun was sent as envoy to Ji Province and Cang to Yan Province to distribute loans. The displaced people all obtained relief.

sentences.zh: 夏，旱。

translations.literal: In summer, there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In summer there was drought.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙寅，皇太后幸洛陽寺及若盧獄錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, the empress dowager visited Luoyang prison and the Ruolu prison to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, the empress dowager visited Luoyang prison and the Ruolu prison to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 洛陽有囚，實不殺人而被考自誣，羸困輿見，畏吏不敢言，將去，舉頭若欲自訴。

translations.literal: In Luoyang there was a prisoner who in truth had not killed anyone yet under torture confessed falsely; emaciated and exhausted, he was carried in a cart to be seen, feared the officials and dared not speak—about to leave, he raised his head as if wishing to plead his own case.
translations.idiomatic: In Luoyang a prisoner had in truth not killed anyone yet under torture confessed falsely. Emaciated and exhausted, he was carried in a cart to be seen. He feared the officials and dared not speak, but as he was about to leave he raised his head as if wishing to plead his case.

sentences.zh: 太后察視覺之，即呼還問狀，具得枉實。

translations.literal: The empress dowager on close inspection perceived him, at once called him back to question the case, and fully obtained the truth of the injustice.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager on close inspection perceived him, called him back at once to question the case, and fully learned the truth of the injustice.

sentences.zh: 即時收洛陽令下獄抵罪。

translations.literal: At once she seized the magistrate of Luoyang, cast him into prison, and punished his crime.
translations.idiomatic: At once she seized the magistrate of Luoyang, cast him into prison, and punished his crime.

sentences.zh: 行未還宮，澍雨大降。

translations.literal: Before she had returned to the palace on her way, a timely rain fell greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Before she had returned to the palace on her way, a timely rain fell in abundance.

sentences.zh: 六月，京師及郡國四十大水，大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the capital and forty commanderies and kingdoms had great floods, great winds, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the capital and forty commanderies and kingdoms suffered great floods, great winds, and hail.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，太白入北斗。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Taibai entered the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Venus entered the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 閏月，辛丑，廣川王常保薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinchou day, Prince Changbao of Guangchuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinchou day, Prince Changbao of Guangchuan died.

sentences.zh: 無子，國除。

translations.literal: He had no sons—the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He had no sons, and the state was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蜀郡徼外羌舉士內屬。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Qiang beyond the border markers of Shu Commandery presented scholars and submitted within.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Qiang beyond the border markers of Shu Commandery presented scholars and submitted.

sentences.zh: 冬，鄧騭使任尚及從事中郎河內司馬鈞率諸郡兵，與滇零等數萬人戰於平襄，尚軍大敗，死者八千餘人，羌眾遂大盛，朝廷不能制。

translations.literal: In winter, Deng Zhi sent Ren Shang and Attendant Gentleman Sima Jun of Henei to lead commandery troops to fight with Dianling and others, tens of thousands, at Pingxiang. Shang's army was greatly defeated; the dead were more than eight thousand. The Qiang masses thereupon grew greatly powerful, and the court could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Deng Zhi sent Ren Shang and Attendant Gentleman Sima Jun of Henei to lead commandery troops against Dianling and others, tens of thousands, at Pingxiang. Shang's army was routed; more than eight thousand died. The Qiang masses thereupon grew greatly powerful, and the court could not control them.

sentences.zh: 湟中諸縣，粟石萬錢，百姓死亡不可勝數，而轉運難劇。

translations.literal: In the various counties of Huangzhong, grain was ten thousand cash per shi; the people's deaths could not be counted, and transport was hard and severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the counties of Huangzhong grain cost ten thousand cash per shi. The people's deaths could not be counted, and transport was desperately hard.

sentences.zh: 故左校令河南龐參先坐法輸作若盧，使其子俊上書曰：「方今西州流民擾動，而征發不絕，水潦不沐，地力不復，重之以大軍，疲之以遠戍，農功消於轉運，資財竭於征發，田疇不得墾闢，禾稼不得收入，搏手困窮，無望來秋，百姓力屈，不復堪命。

translations.literal: Former Left Commandant of the Palace Pang Can of Henan, having first been charged by law and sent to labor at Ruolu, had his son Jun submit a memorial saying: "Just now the western provinces' displaced people are disturbed and in motion, yet levies and drafts do not cease; flooding has not been washed away, the land's strength has not recovered, and on top of this there is the great army, wearied by distant garrison—agricultural work is consumed in transport, resources are exhausted in levies, fields cannot be opened and reclaimed, grain cannot be gathered in; wringing hands in destitution, no hope for next autumn—the people's strength is bent and they can no longer bear the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Former Left Commandant of the Palace Pang Can of Henan, having first been charged by law and sent to labor at Ruolu, had his son Jun submit a memorial saying, "Just now the western provinces' displaced people are disturbed, yet levies and drafts do not cease. Flooding has not been washed away and the land's strength has not recovered. On top of this is the great army, wearied by distant garrison. Agricultural work is consumed in transport and resources exhausted in levies. Fields cannot be opened and grain cannot be gathered. Wringing their hands in destitution, the people have no hope for next autumn. Their strength is spent and they can no longer bear the burden."

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為萬里運糧，遠就羌戎，不若總兵養眾，以待其疲。

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly holds that transporting grain ten thousand li and going far to meet the Qiang and Rong is not as good as gathering troops and nurturing the masses to await their exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant foolishly holds that transporting grain ten thousand li to fight the Qiang and Rong far away is not as good as gathering troops and nurturing the masses to await their exhaustion."

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍騭宜且振旅，留征西校尉任尚，使督涼州士民轉居三輔，休徭役以助其時，止煩賦以益其財，令男得耕種，女得織紝，然後畜精銳，乘懈沮，出其不意，攻其不備，則邊民之仇報，奔北之恥雪矣。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhi ought for the time to withdraw the army, leave Colonel of the Western Expedition Ren Shang, have him oversee Liang Province gentry and people in moving to settle in the Three Metropolises, rest corvée labor to aid their season, stop troublesome levies to increase their wealth, order men to be able to plow and sow and women to be able to weave, and then store elite troops, ride their slackness and discouragement, go out where they do not expect, strike where they are unprepared—then the border people's revenge will be answered and the shame of flight north will be wiped away.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhi ought for the time to withdraw the army and leave Colonel of the Western Expedition Ren Shang to oversee moving Liang Province gentry and people to settle in the Three Metropolises, rest corvée labor to aid their season, and stop troublesome levies to increase their wealth, so that men may plow and sow and women weave. Then store elite troops, ride their slackness and discouragement, strike where they do not expect and are unprepared, and the border people's revenge will be answered and the shame of flight north wiped away."

sentences.zh: 」書奏，會樊准上疏薦參，太后即擢參於徒中，召拜謁者，使西督三輔諸軍屯。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; it happened that Fan Zhun submitted a memorial recommending Can—the empress dowager at once promoted Can from among the convicts, summoned and appointed him Herald, and sent him west to oversee the Three Metropolises' various encamped armies.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted. It happened that Fan Zhun also recommended Can. The empress dowager at once promoted Can from among the convicts, summoned and appointed him Herald, and sent him west to oversee the encamped armies of the Three Metropolises.

sentences.zh: 十一月，辛酉，詔鄧騭還師，留任尚屯漢陽為諸軍節度。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinyou day, an edict ordered Deng Zhi to return the army; Ren Shang was left encamped at Hanyang as coordinator of the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou day, an edict ordered Deng Zhi to return the army. Ren Shang was left encamped at Hanyang as coordinator of the armies.

sentences.zh: 遣使迎拜騭為大將軍。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to welcome and invest Zhi as Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to welcome and invest Zhi as Grand General.

sentences.zh: 既至，使大鴻臚親迎，中常侍郊勞，王、主以下候望於道，寵靈顯赫，光震都鄙。

translations.literal: When he arrived, the Grand Herald was sent to welcome him in person, a Regular Palace Attendant to salute him in the suburbs; princes, princesses, and those below waited and watched on the road—favor and spiritual grace were brilliant and manifest, their light shaking capital and outskirts.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, the Grand Herald welcomed him in person and a Regular Palace Attendant saluted him in the suburbs. Princes, princesses, and those below waited along the road. Favor and grace were brilliant and manifest, their light shaking capital and outskirts.

sentences.zh: 滇零自稱天子，於北地招集武都參狼、上郡、西河諸雜種羌斷隴道，寇鈔三輔，南入益州，殺漢中太守董炳。

translations.literal: Dianling styled himself Son of Heaven; at Beidi he gathered Wudu Canlang, Shang, Xihe, and the various mixed Qiang tribes, cut the Long Road, raided and plundered the Three Metropolises, entered Yi Province southward, and killed Administrator of Hanzhong Dong Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Dianling styled himself Son of Heaven. At Beidi he gathered the Canlang of Wudu, Shang, Xihe, and various mixed Qiang tribes, cut the Long Road, raided the Three Metropolises, entered Yi Province southward, and killed Administrator of Hanzhong Dong Bing.

sentences.zh: 梁慬受詔當屯金城，聞羌寇三輔，即引兵赴擊，轉戰武功、美陽間，連破走之，羌稍退散。

translations.literal: Liang Xi received orders to encamp at Jincheng; hearing the Qiang raided the Three Metropolises, he at once led troops to go strike them, fighting repeatedly between Wugong and Meiyang, repeatedly defeating and driving them off—the Qiang gradually withdrew and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xi was ordered to encamp at Jincheng. Hearing the Qiang raided the Three Metropolises, he led troops at once to strike them, fighting repeatedly between Wugong and Meiyang, repeatedly defeating and driving them off until the Qiang gradually withdrew and scattered.

sentences.zh: 十二月，廣漢塞外參狼羌降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Canlang Qiang beyond the passes of Guanghan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Canlang Qiang beyond the passes of Guanghan submitted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國十二地震。

translations.literal: This year, twelve commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: This year twelve commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，庚子，皇帝加元服，赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on gengzi day, the emperor performed the capping ceremony and amnestied the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on gengzi day, the emperor performed the capping ceremony and amnestied the realm.

sentences.zh: 遣騎都尉任仁督諸郡屯兵救三輔。

translations.literal: Colonel of Cavalry Ren Ren was sent to oversee commandery encamped troops to rescue the Three Metropolises.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel of Cavalry Ren Ren was sent to oversee commandery encamped troops to rescue the Three Metropolises.

sentences.zh: 仁戰數不利，當煎、勒姐羌攻沒破羌縣，鍾羌攻沒臨洮縣，執隴西南部都尉。

translations.literal: Ren fought several times without success; the Dangjian and Lejie Qiang attacked and overran Poqiang county; the Zhong Qiang attacked and overran Lintao county and seized the Colonel of the Western Expedition of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ren fought several times without success. The Dangjian and Lejie Qiang attacked and overran Poqiang county. The Zhong Qiang attacked and overran Lintao county and seized the Colonel of the Western Expedition of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 三月，京師大饑，民相食。

translations.literal: In the third month, the capital suffered great famine; the people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the capital suffered great famine and the people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，公卿詣闕謝；

translations.literal: On renchen day, the excellencies and ministers came to the court to apologize;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the excellencies and ministers came to court to apologize;

sentences.zh: 詔「務思變復，以助不逮。

translations.literal: an edict: "Strive to think of change and recovery to aid what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: an edict ordered, "Strive to think of change and recovery to aid what is lacking."

sentences.zh: 壬寅，司徒魯恭罷。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Minister of Education Lu Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Minister of Education Lu Gong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 恭再在公位，選辟高第至列卿、郡守者數十人，而門下耆舊或不蒙薦舉，至有怨望者。

translations.literal: Gong twice held excellency; those he selected and summoned with high grades who reached ranked ministers and administrators numbered several tens, yet elders among his disciples sometimes did not receive recommendation—even to the point of those who bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Gong twice held excellency. Several tens of those he selected and summoned with high grades reached ranked ministers and administrators, yet elders among his disciples sometimes did not receive recommendation, and some bore resentment.

sentences.zh: 恭聞之，曰：「學之不講，是吾憂也，諸生不有鄉舉者乎！

translations.literal: Gong heard of it and said, "That learning is not expounded is my worry—do the students not have village recommendations!"
translations.idiomatic: Gong heard of it and said, "That learning is not expounded is my worry. Do the students not have village recommendations!"

sentences.zh: 」終無所言，亦不借之議論。

translations.literal: " In the end he said nothing more and did not lend them discussion.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he said nothing more and would not discuss it with them.

sentences.zh: 學者受業，必窮核問難，道成，然後謝遣之。

translations.literal: Students who received his teaching had inevitably to exhaust investigation and questioning in difficulty; when the Way was accomplished, only then were they dismissed and sent off.
translations.idiomatic: Students who received his teaching had to exhaust investigation and questioning in difficulty. Only when the Way was accomplished were they dismissed.

sentences.zh: 學者曰：「魯公謝與議論，不可虛得。

translations.literal: Students said, "Duke Lu's dismissal and discussion cannot be obtained in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Students said, "Duke Lu's dismissal and discussion cannot be obtained in vain."

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丙寅，以大鴻臚九江夏勤為司徒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingyin day, Grand Herald Xia Qin of Jiujiang was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on bingyin day, Grand Herald Xia Qin of Jiujiang was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 三公以國用未足，奏令吏民入錢穀得為關內侯、虎賁、羽林郎、五官、大夫、官府吏、緹騎、營士各有差。

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies because state expenses were not sufficient memorialized ordering officials and people who contributed cash and grain to obtain, with respective differences, Marquis Within the Passes, Tiger's Fang, Forest Army gentleman, Five Offices, Grandee, government office clerk, brocade-clad rider, and camp soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Because state expenses were insufficient the Three Excellencies memorialized that officials and people who contributed cash and grain might obtain, with respective differences, Marquis Within the Passes, Tiger's Fang, Forest Army gentleman, Five Offices, Grandee, government clerk, brocade-clad rider, and camp soldier.

sentences.zh: 甲申，清河愍王虎威薨，無子。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Prince Min of Qinghe Huwei died without sons.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince Min of Qinghe Huwei died without sons.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙申，封樂安王寵子延平為清河王，奉孝王后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Yanping, son of Prince Chong of Le'an, was enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe to serve the empress of filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Yanping, son of Prince Chong of Le'an, was enfeoffed as Prince of Qinghe to serve the empress of filial piety.

sentences.zh: 六月，漁陽烏恆與右北平胡千餘寇代郡、上谷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Wuhuan of Yuyang and more than a thousand Hu of Youbeiping raided Dai and Shanggu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wuhuan of Yuyang and more than a thousand Hu of Youbeiping raided Dai and Shanggu.

sentences.zh: 漢人韓琮隨匈奴南單于入朝，既還，說南單于云：「關東水潦，人民飢餓死盡，可擊也。

translations.literal: The Han man Han Cong followed the Southern Chanyu of the Xiongnu to court; when he had returned, he told the Southern Chanyu, "East of the Pass there is flooding; the people are hungry and starved to extinction—it can be struck.
translations.idiomatic: The Han man Han Cong followed the Southern Chanyu of the Xiongnu to court. When he returned, he told the Southern Chanyu, "East of the Pass there is flooding. The people are hungry and starved to extinction. You can strike."

sentences.zh: 」單于信其言，遂反。

translations.literal: " The chanyu believed his words and thereupon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: " The chanyu believed him and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，海賊張伯路等寇濱海九郡，殺二千石、令、長；

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the sea bandits Zhang Bolu and others raided nine coastal commanderies, killing two-thousand-dan officials, magistrates, and chiefs;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the sea bandits Zhang Bolu and others raided nine coastal commanderies, killing two-thousand-dan officials, magistrates, and chiefs;

sentences.zh: 遣侍御史巴郡龐雄督州郡兵擊之，伯路等乞降，尋復屯聚。

translations.literal: Attendant Imperial Secretary Pang Xiong of Ba was sent to oversee commandery and state troops to strike them; Bolu and the others begged to submit, but soon again gathered and encamped.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Imperial Secretary Pang Xiong of Ba was sent to oversee commandery and state troops to strike them. Bolu and the others begged to submit but soon gathered again.

sentences.zh: 九月，雁門烏桓率眾王無何允與鮮卑大人丘倫等，及南匈奴骨都侯合七千騎寇五原，與太守戰於高渠谷，漢兵大敗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Wuhuan of Yanmen, the chieftain-king Wuhe Yun, with the Xianbei great chief Qiulun and others, and the Southern Xiongnu Gudu Marquis together, seven thousand horsemen raided Wuyuan and fought the administrator at Gaoqu Valley—the Han troops were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wuhuan of Yanmen, chieftain-king Wuhe Yun, the Xianbei great chief Qiulun and others, and the Southern Xiongnu Gudu Marquis together led seven thousand horsemen to raid Wuyuan and fought the administrator at Gaoqu Valley. Han troops were routed.

sentences.zh: 南單于圍中郎將耿種於美稷。

translations.literal: The Southern Chanyu besieged Commandant of the Gentlemen Geng Zhong at Meiji.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Chanyu besieged Commandant of the Gentlemen Geng Zhong at Meiji.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，以大司農陳國何熙行車騎將軍事，中郎將龐雄為副，將五營及邊郡兵二萬餘人，又詔遼東太守耿夔率鮮卑及諸郡兵共擊之。
