translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Grand Minister of Agriculture He Xi of Chen was put in charge of Chariots and Cavalry military affairs, with Colonel of the Gentlemen Pang Xiong as deputy, leading more than twenty thousand troops of the Five Camps and frontier commanderies; an edict also ordered Administrator of Liaodong Geng Kui to lead Xianbei and troops of the various commanderies to attack jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, Grand Minister of Agriculture He Xi of Chen was put in charge of Chariots and Cavalry military affairs, with Colonel of the Gentlemen Pang Xiong as deputy, leading more than twenty thousand troops of the Five Camps and frontier commanderies. An edict also ordered Administrator of Liaodong Geng Kui to lead Xianbei and troops from the various commanderies to attack jointly.

sentences.zh: 以梁慬行度遼將軍事。

translations.literal: Liang Qin was put in charge of General Who Crosses the Liao military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Qin was put in charge of General Who Crosses the Liao military affairs.

sentences.zh: 雄、夔擊南匈奴薁鞬日逐王，破之。

translations.literal: Xiong and Kui attacked the Southern Xiongnu Yuwu Rizhu King and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xiong and Geng Kui attacked the Southern Xiongnu Yuwu Rizhu King and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，辛酉，郡國九地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, nine commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou day, nine commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，有星孛於天苑。

translations.literal: On yihai, a broom star appeared in Celestial Park.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, a broom star appeared in Celestial Park.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師及郡國四十一雨水，并、涼二州大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: That year the capital and forty-one commanderies and states had rain and flood; Bing and Liang provinces suffered great famine and men ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital and forty-one commanderies and states suffered rain and flooding. Bing and Liang provinces suffered a great famine, and people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 太后以陰陽不和，軍旅數興，詔歲終饗遣衛士勿設戲作樂，減逐疫侲子之半。

translations.literal: Because yin and yang were not in harmony and armies were frequently raised, the Empress Dowager ordered that at the year-end feast dismissing the guards there be no theatrical performances or music, and that plague-exorcism puppet performers be reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Because yin and yang were not in harmony and armies were frequently raised, the Empress Dowager ordered that at the year-end feast dismissing the guards there be no theatrical performances or music, and that plague-exorcism puppet performers be reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，元會，徹樂，不陳充庭車。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, at the New Year assembly, music was removed and the filling-court chariots were not displayed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, at the New Year assembly, music was removed and the filling-court chariots were not displayed.

sentences.zh: 鄧騭在位，頗能推進賢士，薦何熙、李郃等列於朝廷，又辟弘農楊震、巴郡陳禪等置之幕府，天下稱之。

translations.literal: Deng Bi held office and was quite able to advance worthy men; he recommended He Xi, Li He, and others to the court, and also recruited Yang Zhen of Hongnong, Chen Chan of Bajun, and others to his staff—all under heaven praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Bi held office and was quite able to advance worthy men. He recommended He Xi, Li He, and others to the court, and also recruited Yang Zhen of Hongnong, Chen Chan of Bajun, and others to his staff. All under heaven praised him.

sentences.zh: 震孤貧好學，明歐陽《尚書》，通達博覽，諸儒為之語曰：「關西孔子楊伯起。

translations.literal: Zhen was orphaned and poor yet loved learning, mastered Ouyang's Documents of the Sage, and was broadly learned; the Confucians said of him: "The Confucius of Guanxi—Yang Boqi."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen was orphaned and poor yet loved learning. He mastered Ouyang's Documents of the Sage and was broadly learned. The Confucians said of him, "The Confucius of Guanxi—Yang Boqi."

sentences.zh: 」教授二十餘年，不答州郡禮命，眾人謂之晚暮，而震志愈篤。

translations.literal: " He taught for more than twenty years and did not accept provincial appointments; the crowd called this tardiness in his career, yet Zhen's resolve grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: " He taught for more than twenty years and did not accept provincial appointments. The crowd called this tardiness in his career, yet Yang Zhen's resolve grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 騭聞而辟之，時震年已五十餘，累遷荊州刺史、東萊太守。

translations.literal: Bi heard of him and recruited him; Zhen was already more than fifty and was successively promoted to Governor of Jing Province and Administrator of Donglai.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Bi heard of him and recruited him. Yang Zhen was already more than fifty and was successively promoted to Governor of Jing Province and Administrator of Donglai.

sentences.zh: 當之郡，道經昌邑，故所舉荊州茂才王密為昌邑令，夜懷金十斤以遺震。

translations.literal: When he was going to his commandery he passed through Changyi; Wang Mi of Jing Province, a maocai he had formerly recommended, was magistrate of Changyi and at night carried ten jin of gold to present to Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: When he was going to his commandery he passed through Changyi. Wang Mi of Jing Province, a maocai he had formerly recommended, was magistrate of Changyi and at night carried ten jin of gold to present to Yang Zhen.

sentences.zh: 震曰：「故人知君，君不知故人，何也？

translations.literal: Zhen said: "An old friend knew you—why do you not know your old friend?"
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhen said, "An old friend knew you—why do you not know your old friend?"

sentences.zh: 」密曰：「暮夜無知者。

translations.literal: " Mi said: "At night no one would know."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mi said, "At night no one would know."

sentences.zh: 」震曰：「天知，地知，我知，子知，何謂無知者！

translations.literal: " Zhen said: "Heaven knows, earth knows, I know, and you know—what do you mean by saying no one would know!"
translations.idiomatic: " Yang Zhen said, "Heaven knows, earth knows, I know, and you know—what do you mean by saying no one would know!"

sentences.zh: 」密愧而出。

translations.literal: " Mi left in shame.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mi left in shame.

sentences.zh: 後轉涿郡太守。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to be Administrator of Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to be Administrator of Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 性公廉，子孫常蔬食、步行；

translations.literal: By nature he was just and incorrupt; his descendants often ate plain food and went on foot;
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was just and incorrupt. His descendants often ate plain food and went on foot;

sentences.zh: 故舊或欲令為開產業，震不肯，曰：「使後世稱為清白吏子孫，以此遺之，不亦厚乎！

translations.literal: old friends sometimes wished him to establish estates, but Zhen refused, saying: "To let posterity call us descendants of an incorrupt official and leave them this—is it not a rich legacy!"
translations.idiomatic: old friends sometimes wished him to establish estates, but Yang Zhen refused, saying, "To let posterity call us descendants of an incorrupt official and leave them this—is it not a rich legacy!"

sentences.zh: 」張伯路復攻郡縣，殺吏，黨眾浸盛。

translations.literal: " Zhang Bolu again attacked commanderies and counties, killed officials, and his faction grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Bolu again attacked commanderies and counties, killed officials, and his faction grew ever stronger.

sentences.zh: 詔遣御史中丞王宗持節發幽、冀諸郡兵合數萬人，征宛陵令扶風法雄為青州刺史，與宗並力討之。

translations.literal: An edict sent Imperial Secretary Wang Zong with credentials to mobilize troops of You and Ji commanderies totaling tens of thousands, summoned Wanling Magistrate Fa Xiong of Fufeng to be Governor of Qing Province, and had him join Zong in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Imperial Secretary Wang Zong with credentials to mobilize troops from You and Ji commanderies totaling tens of thousands, summoned Wanling Magistrate Fa Xiong of Fufeng to be Governor of Qing Province, and had him join Wang Zong in suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 南單于圍耿種數月，梁慬、耿夔擊斬其別將於屬國故城，單于自將迎戰，慬等復破之，單于遂引還虎澤。

translations.literal: The Southern Chanyu besieged Geng Zhong for months; Liang Qin and Geng Kui attacked and beheaded his deputy general at the old city of the Dependent State; the Chanyu personally led troops to meet them in battle; Qin and others defeated him again, and the Chanyu thereupon withdrew to Huzhe.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Chanyu besieged Geng Zhong for months. Liang Qin and Geng Kui attacked and beheaded his deputy general at the old city of the Dependent State. The Chanyu personally led troops to meet them in battle, but Qin and others defeated him again, and the Chanyu thereupon withdrew to Huzhe.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔減百官及州郡縣奉各有差。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict reduced the salaries of officials and of commandery, prefecture, and county staffs by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, an edict reduced the salaries of officials and of commandery, prefecture, and county staffs by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 二月，南匈奴寇常山。

translations.literal: In the second month the Southern Xiongnu raided Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Southern Xiongnu raided Changshan.

sentences.zh: 滇零遣兵寇褒中，漢中太守鄭勤移屯褒中。

translations.literal: Diangling sent troops to raid Baozhong; Administrator of Hanzhong Zheng Qin moved his camp to Baozhong.
translations.idiomatic: Diangling sent troops to raid Baozhong, and Administrator of Hanzhong Zheng Qin moved his camp to Baozhong.

sentences.zh: 任尚軍久出無功，民廢農桑，乃詔尚將吏兵還屯長安，罷遣南陽、穎川、汝南吏士。

translations.literal: Ren Shang's army had been out long without success and the people abandoned farming and sericulture; an edict then ordered Shang to lead officers, clerks, and troops back to encamp at Chang'an and dismissed the officers and soldiers of Nanyang, Yingchuan, and Runan.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang's army had been out long without success and the people abandoned farming and sericulture. An edict then ordered Shang to lead officers, clerks, and troops back to encamp at Chang'an and dismissed the officers and soldiers of Nanyang, Yingchuan, and Runan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，初置京兆虎牙都尉於長安，扶風都尉於雍，如西京三輔都尉故事。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Jingzhao Huya Commandant was first established at Chang'an and the Fufeng Commandant at Yong, following the precedent of the Western Capital's Three Assistants commandants.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Jingzhao Huya Commandant was first established at Chang'an and the Fufeng Commandant at Yong, following the precedent of the Western Capital's Three Assistants commandants.

sentences.zh: 謁者龐參說鄧騭徙邊郡不能自存者入居三輔，騭然之，欲棄涼州，並力北邊。

translations.literal: Gentleman Pang Can persuaded Deng Bi to move people of frontier commanderies unable to sustain themselves into the Three Assistants; Bi agreed and wished to abandon Liang Province and concentrate strength on the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman Pang Can persuaded Deng Bi to move people from frontier commanderies unable to sustain themselves into the Three Assistants. Bi agreed and wished to abandon Liang Province and concentrate strength on the northern border.

sentences.zh: 乃會公卿集議，騭曰：「譬若衣敗壞，一以相補，猶有所完，若不如此，將兩無所保。

translations.literal: He then convened the ministers for joint deliberation and said: "It is like clothes that are torn—if you patch them together, something still remains whole; if you do not do so, both parts will be lost."
translations.idiomatic: He then convened the ministers for joint deliberation and said, "It is like clothes that are torn—if you patch them together, something still remains whole. If you do not do so, both parts will be lost."

sentences.zh: 」公卿皆以為然。

translations.literal: " The ministers all thought this correct.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministers all thought this correct.

sentences.zh: 郎中陳國虞詡言於太尉張禹曰：「若大將軍之策，不可者三：先帝開拓土宇，劬勞後定，而今憚小費，舉而棄之，此不可一也。

translations.literal: Gentleman Yu Xu of Chen said to Grand Commandant Zhang Yu: "If the Grand General's plan is adopted, there are three reasons it cannot be done: the Former Emperor opened and expanded the realm, toiling until it was settled, yet now we shrink from small expense and abandon it all at once—this cannot be done, first."
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman Yu Xu of Chen said to Grand Commandant Zhang Yu, "If the Grand General's plan is adopted, there are three reasons it cannot be done. The Former Emperor opened and expanded the realm, toiling until it was settled, yet now we shrink from small expense and abandon it all at once—this cannot be done, first."

sentences.zh: 涼州既棄，即以三輔為塞，則園陵單外，此不可二也。

translations.literal: "Once Liang Province is abandoned, the Three Assistants become the frontier, and the imperial parks and tombs stand alone beyond the border—this cannot be done, second."
translations.idiomatic: "Once Liang Province is abandoned, the Three Assistants become the frontier, and the imperial parks and tombs stand alone beyond the border—this cannot be done, second."

sentences.zh: 喭曰：『關西出將，關東出相。

translations.literal: "The proverb says: 'Generals come from west of the Pass, chancellors from east of the Pass.'"
translations.idiomatic: "The proverb says, 'Generals come from west of the Pass, chancellors from east of the Pass.'"

sentences.zh: 』烈士武臣，多出涼州，士風壯猛，便習兵事。

translations.literal: " Bold warriors and martial ministers mostly come from Liang Province; its customs are vigorous and fierce and men are skilled in military affairs."
translations.idiomatic: " Bold warriors and martial ministers mostly come from Liang Province. Its customs are vigorous and fierce, and men are skilled in military affairs."

sentences.zh: 今羌、胡所以不敢入據三輔為心腹之害者，以涼州在後故也。

translations.literal: "Now the reason the Qiang and Hu do not dare enter and occupy the Three Assistants as a mortal wound is that Liang Province lies behind them."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the reason the Qiang and Hu do not dare enter and occupy the Three Assistants as a mortal wound is that Liang Province lies behind them."

sentences.zh: 涼州士民所以推鋒執銳，蒙矢石於行陳，父死於前，子戰於後，無反顧之心者，為臣屬於漢故也。

translations.literal: "The reason the people of Liang Province thrust forward and grasp sharp weapons, face arrows and stones in the battle line, with fathers dying in front and sons fighting behind without turning back, is that they are subjects of Han."
translations.idiomatic: "The reason the people of Liang Province thrust forward and grasp sharp weapons, face arrows and stones in the battle line, with fathers dying in front and sons fighting behind without turning back, is that they are subjects of Han."

sentences.zh: 今推而捐之，割而棄之，民庶安土重還，必引領而怨曰：『中國棄我於夷狄！

translations.literal: "Now if we thrust them aside and cast them away, cut them off and abandon them, the people will love their land yet be forced to return and will surely stretch their necks in resentment, saying: 'The central state has cast us off to the barbarians!'
translations.idiomatic: "Now if we thrust them aside and cast them away, cut them off and abandon them, the people will love their land yet be forced to return and will surely stretch their necks in resentment, saying, 'The central state has cast us off to the barbarians!'

sentences.zh: 』雖赴義從善之人，不能無恨。

translations.literal: " Even men who rush to righteousness and follow goodness cannot be without resentment."
translations.idiomatic: " Even men who rush to righteousness and follow goodness cannot be without resentment."

sentences.zh: 如卒然起謀，因天下之饑敝，乘海內之虛弱，豪雄相聚，量材立帥，驅氏、羌以為前鋒，席捲而東，雖賁、育為卒，太公為將，猶恐不足當御；

translations.literal: "If they suddenly rise in conspiracy, taking advantage of the empire's famine and exhaustion and the realm's weakness within, heroes gather, choose leaders by ability, drive the Di and Qiang as vanguard, and sweep eastward—even with Ben and Yu as common soldiers and Grand Duke Jiang as general, I fear it would still be insufficient to withstand them;"
translations.idiomatic: "If they suddenly rise in conspiracy, taking advantage of the empire's famine and exhaustion and the realm's weakness within, heroes gather, choose leaders by ability, drive the Di and Qiang as vanguard, and sweep eastward—even with Ben and Yu as common soldiers and Grand Duke Jiang as general, I fear it would still be insufficient to withstand them;"

sentences.zh: 如此，則函谷以西，園陵舊京非復漢有，此不可三也。

translations.literal: "if so, then west of Hangu Pass the imperial parks and the old capital would no longer belong to Han—this cannot be done, third."
translations.idiomatic: "if so, then west of Hangu Pass the imperial parks and the old capital would no longer belong to Han—this cannot be done, third."

sentences.zh: 議者喻以補衣猶有所完，詡恐其疽食侵淫而無限極也！

translations.literal: "Those in the debate likened it to patching clothes so that something still remains whole; Xu feared that like a gangrenous sore eating inward there would be no limit!"
translations.idiomatic: "Those in the debate likened it to patching clothes so that something still remains whole. Xu feared that, like a gangrenous sore eating inward, there would be no limit!"

sentences.zh: 」禹曰：「吾意不及此，微子之言，幾敗國事！

translations.literal: " Yu said: "My thought did not reach this far. But for your words, we would nearly have ruined the state's affairs!"
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Yu said, "My thought did not reach this far. But for your words, we would nearly have ruined the state's affairs!"

sentences.zh: 」詡因說禹：「收羅涼土豪傑，引其牧守子弟於朝，令諸府各辟數人，外以勸厲答其功勤，內以拘致防其邪計。

translations.literal: " Xu thereupon advised Yu: "Gather the great men of Liang Province, bring their governors' and prefects' sons and younger brothers to court, and have each office recruit several men—outwardly to encourage and reward their merit and diligence, inwardly to detain and guard against wicked designs."
translations.idiomatic: " Yu Xu thereupon advised Zhang Yu, "Gather the great men of Liang Province, bring their governors' and prefects' sons and younger brothers to court, and have each office recruit several men—outwardly to encourage and reward their merit and diligence, inwardly to detain and guard against wicked designs."

sentences.zh: 」禹善其言，更集四府，皆從詡議。

translations.literal: " Yu approved his words, reconvened the Four Offices, and all followed Xu's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Yu approved his words, reconvened the Four Offices, and all followed Yu Xu's proposal.

sentences.zh: 於是辟西州豪桀為掾屬，拜牧守、長吏子弟為郎，以安慰之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the great men of the western provinces were recruited as clerks and aides, and the sons and younger brothers of governors, prefects, and senior officials were appointed Gentlemen to reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the great men of the western provinces were recruited as clerks and aides, and the sons and younger brothers of governors, prefects, and senior officials were appointed Gentlemen to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 鄧騭由是惡詡，欲以吏法中傷之。

translations.literal: Deng Bi therefore hated Xu and wished to harm him through the penal code.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Bi therefore hated Yu Xu and wished to harm him through the penal code.

sentences.zh: 會朝歌賊寧季等數千人攻殺長吏，屯聚連年，州郡不能禁，乃以詡為朝歌長。

translations.literal: It happened that the Chaoge bandits Ning Ji and others, several thousand strong, attacked and killed senior officials and gathered for years while the provinces and commanderies could not suppress them; Xu was therefore made magistrate of Chaoge.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Chaoge bandits Ning Ji and others, several thousand strong, attacked and killed senior officials and gathered for years while the provinces and commanderies could not suppress them. Yu Xu was therefore made magistrate of Chaoge.

sentences.zh: 故舊皆吊之，詡笑曰：「事不避難，臣之職也。

translations.literal: Old friends all condoled with him; Xu laughed and said: "Not to shun difficulty in affairs is a minister's duty."
translations.idiomatic: Old friends all condoled with him. Yu Xu laughed and said, "Not to shun difficulty in affairs is a minister's duty."

sentences.zh: 不遇槃根錯節，無以別利器，此乃吾立功之秋也。

translations.literal: "Unless one meets twisted roots and knotted joints, there is no way to distinguish sharp tools—this is the season for me to establish merit."
translations.idiomatic: "Unless one meets twisted roots and knotted joints, there is no way to distinguish sharp tools—this is the season for me to establish merit."

sentences.zh: 」始到，謁河內太守馬稜。

translations.literal: " When he first arrived he called on Administrator of Henei Ma Ling.
translations.idiomatic: " When he first arrived he called on Administrator of Henei Ma Ling.

sentences.zh: 稜曰：「君儒者，當謀謨廟堂，乃在朝歌，甚為君憂之。

translations.literal: Ling said: "You are a Confucian and ought to plan policy in the ancestral temple—yet you are in Chaoge; I am very worried for you."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ling said, "You are a Confucian and ought to plan policy in the ancestral temple—yet you are in Chaoge. I am very worried for you."

sentences.zh: 」詡曰：「此賊犬羊相聚，以求溫飽耳，願明府不以為憂。

translations.literal: " Xu said: "These bandits are dogs and sheep gathered together seeking only food and warmth—I beg the governor not to worry."
translations.idiomatic: " Yu Xu said, "These bandits are dogs and sheep gathered together seeking only food and warmth. I beg the governor not to worry."

sentences.zh: 」稜曰：「何以言之？

translations.literal: " Ling said: "On what grounds do you say so?"
translations.idiomatic: " Ma Ling said, "On what grounds do you say so?"

sentences.zh: 」詡曰：「朝歌者，韓、魏之郊，背太行，臨黃河，去敖倉不過百里，而青、冀之民流亡萬數，賊不知開倉招眾，劫庫兵，守成皋，斷天下右臂，此不足憂也。

translations.literal: " Xu said: "Chaoge is the borderland of Han and Wei, backed by the Taihang Mountains and facing the Yellow River, less than a hundred li from Aocang, while tens of thousands of people from Qing and Ji are refugees—the bandits do not know to open the granaries to gather followers, seize the armory weapons, hold Chenggao, and cut off the empire's right arm. This is not worth worry."
translations.idiomatic: " Yu Xu said, "Chaoge is the borderland of Han and Wei, backed by the Taihang Mountains and facing the Yellow River, less than a hundred li from Aocang, while tens of thousands of people from Qing and Ji are refugees. The bandits do not know to open the granaries to gather followers, seize the armory weapons, hold Chenggao, and cut off the empire's right arm. This is not worth worry."

sentences.zh: 今其眾新盛，難與爭鋒；

translations.literal: "Now their host is newly strong and hard to meet in the clash of arms;
translations.idiomatic: "Now their host is newly strong and hard to meet in the clash of arms;

sentences.zh: 兵不厭權，願寬假轡策，勿令有所拘閡而已。

translations.literal: war does not reject stratagem—I beg you to relax the reins and not let me be constrained."
translations.idiomatic: war does not reject stratagem. I beg you to relax the reins and not let me be constrained."

sentences.zh: 」及到官，設三科以募求壯士，自掾史以下各舉所知，其攻劫者為上，傷人偷盜者次之，不事家業者為下，收得百餘人，詡為饗會，悉貰其罪，使入賊中誘令劫掠，乃伏兵以待之，遂殺賊數百人。

translations.literal: " When he took office he set three categories to recruit stalwart men; from clerks downward each recommended those he knew—robbers and plunderers ranked highest, wounders and thieves next, and those who neglected their households lowest. More than a hundred were gathered; Xu held a feast, pardoned all their crimes, and sent them into the bandits to lure them to raid; then he set ambush troops to wait and killed several hundred bandits.
translations.idiomatic: " When he took office he set three categories to recruit stalwart men. From clerks downward each recommended those he knew—robbers and plunderers ranked highest, wounders and thieves next, and those who neglected their households lowest. More than a hundred were gathered. Yu Xu held a feast, pardoned all their crimes, and sent them into the bandits to lure them to raid. Then he set ambush troops to wait and killed several hundred bandits.

sentences.zh: 又潛遣貧人能縫者傭作賊衣，以采線縫其裾，有出市裡者，吏輒禽之。

translations.literal: He also secretly sent poor men who could sew to work as hired tailors for the bandits' clothes, stitching colored thread into the hems; when anyone went out into the market the officials seized him.
translations.idiomatic: He also secretly sent poor men who could sew to work as hired tailors for the bandits' clothes, stitching colored thread into the hems. When anyone went out into the market the officials seized him.

sentences.zh: 賊由是駭散，咸稱神明，縣境皆平。

translations.literal: The bandits were thereby terrified and scattered; all called him divine, and the county was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were thereby terrified and scattered. All called him divine, and the county was entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月，何熙軍到五原曼柏，暴疾，不能進；

translations.literal: In the third month He Xi's army reached Manbai in Wuyuan and was stricken with sudden illness and could not advance;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month He Xi's army reached Manbai in Wuyuan and was stricken with sudden illness and could not advance;

sentences.zh: 遣龐雄與梁慬、耿種將步騎萬六千人攻虎澤，連營稍前。

translations.literal: he sent Pang Xiong with Liang Qin and Geng Zhong to lead sixteen thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Huzhe, advancing camp by camp.
translations.idiomatic: he sent Pang Xiong with Liang Qin and Geng Zhong to lead sixteen thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Huzhe, advancing camp by camp.

sentences.zh: 單于見諸軍並進，大恐怖，顧讓韓琮曰：「汝言漢人死盡，今是何等人也！

translations.literal: The Chanyu saw the armies advancing together and was greatly terrified; he turned and reproached Han Cong: "You said the Han people were all dead—who are these men now!"
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu saw the armies advancing together and was greatly terrified. He turned and reproached Han Cong, "You said the Han people were all dead—who are these men now!"

sentences.zh: 」乃遣使乞降，許之。

translations.literal: " He then sent envoys to beg surrender, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " He then sent envoys to beg surrender, and this was granted.

sentences.zh: 單于脫帽徒跣，對龐雄等拜陳，道死罪。

translations.literal: The Chanyu removed his hat and went barefoot, bowed before Pang Xiong and the others, and confessed capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu removed his hat and went barefoot, bowed before Pang Xiong and the others, and confessed capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 於是赦之，遇待如初，乃還所鈔漢民男女及羌所略轉賣入匈奴中者合萬餘人。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was pardoned and treated as before; he then returned Han men and women he had seized and those the Qiang had captured and resold into the Xiongnu—more than ten thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was pardoned and treated as before. He then returned Han men and women he had seized and those the Qiang had captured and resold into the Xiongnu—more than ten thousand in all.

sentences.zh: 會熙卒，即拜梁慬度遼將軍。

translations.literal: It happened that Xi died, and Liang Qin was immediately appointed General Who Crosses the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that He Xi died, and Liang Qin was immediately appointed General Who Crosses the Liao.

sentences.zh: 龐雄還，為大鴻臚。

translations.literal: Pang Xiong returned and was made Grand Herald.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Xiong returned and was made Grand Herald.

sentences.zh: 先零羌復寇褒中，鄭勤欲擊之，主簿段崇諫，以為「虜乘勝，鋒不可當，宜堅守待之。

translations.literal: The Xianling Qiang again raided Baozhong; Zheng Qin wished to attack them; Registrar Duan Chong remonstrated, holding that "the barbarians ride victory—their edge cannot be met; we should hold firm and wait."
translations.idiomatic: The Xianling Qiang again raided Baozhong. Zheng Qin wished to attack them, but Registrar Duan Chong remonstrated, holding that "the barbarians ride victory—their edge cannot be met. We should hold firm and wait."

sentences.zh: 」勤不從，出戰，大敗，死者三千餘人，段崇及門下吏王宗、原展以身扞刃，與勤俱死。

translations.literal: " Qin did not follow this, went out to battle, and was greatly defeated; more than three thousand died; Duan Chong and his retainers Wang Zong and Yuan Zhan used their bodies to block blades and died with Qin.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng Qin did not follow this, went out to battle, and was greatly defeated. More than three thousand died. Duan Chong and his retainers Wang Zong and Yuan Zhan used their bodies to block blades and died with Zheng Qin.

sentences.zh: 徙金城郡居襄武。

translations.literal: Jincheng Commandery was moved to dwell at Xiangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Jincheng Commandery was moved to dwell at Xiangwu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，杜陵園火。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the park at Duling caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the park at Duling caught fire.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，郡國九地震。

translations.literal: On guisi, nine commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, nine commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，六州蝗。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, six provinces had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, six provinces suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingchou, amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, an amnesty was declared for all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 王宗、法雄與張伯路連戰，破走之，會赦到，賊以軍未解甲，不敢歸降。

translations.literal: Wang Zong and Fa Xiong fought Zhang Bolu repeatedly, defeated and drove him off; when the amnesty arrived the bandits, because the army had not yet laid aside armor, dared not return to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zong and Fa Xiong fought Zhang Bolu repeatedly, defeated him, and drove him off. When the amnesty arrived the bandits, because the army had not yet laid aside armor, dared not return to surrender.

sentences.zh: 王宗召刺史太守共議，皆以為當遂擊之，法雄曰：「不然。

translations.literal: Wang Zong summoned the inspectors and administrators for joint deliberation; all held that they should press the attack; Fa Xiong said: "Not so."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zong summoned the inspectors and administrators for joint deliberation. All held that they should press the attack. Fa Xiong said, "Not so."

sentences.zh: 兵凶器，戰危事，勇不可恃，勝不可必。

translations.literal: "Arms are baleful instruments; battle is a perilous affair—courage cannot be relied on, victory cannot be assured."
translations.idiomatic: "Arms are baleful instruments and battle is a perilous affair. Courage cannot be relied on and victory cannot be assured."

sentences.zh: 賊若乘船浮海，深入遠島，攻之未易也。

translations.literal: "If the bandits take boats and float upon the sea to deep remote islands, they will not be easy to attack."
translations.idiomatic: "If the bandits take boats and float upon the sea to deep remote islands, they will not be easy to attack."

sentences.zh: 及有赦令，可且罷兵以慰誘其心，勢必解散，然後圖之，可不戰而定也。

translations.literal: "Now that there is an amnesty edict, we may for the moment dismiss the troops to comfort and entice their hearts; they will surely disperse, and then we may plan against them—settled without battle."
translations.idiomatic: "Now that there is an amnesty edict, we may for the moment dismiss the troops to comfort and entice their hearts. They will surely disperse, and then we may plan against them—settled without battle."

sentences.zh: 」宗善其言，即罷兵。

translations.literal: " Zong approved his words and immediately dismissed the troops.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Zong approved his words and immediately dismissed the troops.

sentences.zh: 賊聞，大喜，乃還所略人；

translations.literal: When the bandits heard this they were greatly pleased and returned those they had seized;
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits heard this they were greatly pleased and returned those they had seized;

sentences.zh: 而東萊郡兵獨未爭甲，賊復驚恐，遁走遼東，止海島上。

translations.literal: but the troops of Donglai Commandery alone had not yet laid aside armor; the bandits were again alarmed, fled to Liaodong, and stopped on a sea island.
translations.idiomatic: but the troops of Donglai Commandery alone had not yet laid aside armor. The bandits were again alarmed, fled to Liaodong, and stopped on a sea island.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，乙酉，三郡大水。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yiyou, three commanderies had great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on yiyou day, three commanderies suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 騎都尉任仁與羌戰累敗，而兵士放縱，檻車征詣延尉，死。

translations.literal: Commandant of the Rapid Cavalry Ren Ren fought the Qiang repeatedly and was defeated; his soldiers were also undisciplined; he was summoned in a prisoner cart to the Minister of Justice and died.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of the Rapid Cavalry Ren Ren fought the Qiang repeatedly and was defeated. His soldiers were also undisciplined. He was summoned in a prisoner cart to the Minister of Justice and died.

sentences.zh: 護羌校尉段禧卒，復以前校尉侯霸代之，移居張掖。

translations.literal: Protector of the Qiang Duan Xi died; the former protector Hou Ba was again appointed in his place and moved his seat to Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: Protector of the Qiang Duan Xi died. The former protector Hou Ba was again appointed in his place and moved his seat to Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 九月，甲申，益州郡地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiashen, Yi Province and its commanderies had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen day, Yi Province and its commanderies had an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 皇太后母新野君病，太后幸其第，連日宿止；

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's mother the Lady of Xinye was ill; the Empress Dowager visited her residence and lodged there for days;
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's mother the Lady of Xinye was ill. The Empress Dowager visited her residence and lodged there for days;

sentences.zh: 三公上表固爭，乃還宮。

translations.literal: the Three Excellencies submitted memorials firmly remonstrating, and she then returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: the Three Excellencies submitted memorials firmly remonstrating, and she then returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，甲戌，新野君薨，使司空護喪事，儀比東海恭王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiaxu, the Lady of Xinye died; the Minister of Works was ordered to oversee the funeral, with rites comparable to Prince Gong of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on jiaxu day, the Lady of Xinye died. The Minister of Works was ordered to oversee the funeral, with rites comparable to Prince Gong of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 鄧騭等乞身行服，太后欲不許，以問曹大家，大家上疏曰：「妾聞謙讓之風，德莫大焉。

translations.literal: Deng Bi and others begged to retire and observe mourning; the Empress Dowager wished not to grant it and asked Lady Cao; she submitted: "Your servant has heard that the spirit of modest yielding is the greatest of virtues."
translations.idiomatic: Deng Bi and others begged to retire and observe mourning. The Empress Dowager wished not to grant it and asked Lady Cao. She submitted, "Your servant has heard that the spirit of modest yielding is the greatest of virtues."

sentences.zh: 今四舅深執忠孝，引身自退，而以方垂未靜，拒而不許，如後有豪毛加於今日，誠恐推讓之名不可再得。

translations.literal: "Now the four uncles deeply hold loyalty and filial piety and withdraw themselves, yet because the realm is not yet settled you refuse them—I truly fear that if even a hair's breadth is added to today's burden, the name of yielding may never be won again."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the four uncles deeply hold loyalty and filial piety and withdraw themselves, yet because the realm is not yet settled you refuse them. I truly fear that if even a hair's breadth is added to today's burden, the name of yielding may never be won again."

sentences.zh: 」太后乃許之。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager thereupon granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager thereupon granted it.

sentences.zh: 乃服除，詔騭復還輔朝政，更授前封，騭等叩頭固讓，乃止。

translations.literal: When mourning ended an edict ordered Bi to return and assist court government and again grant his former fiefs; Bi and the others knocked their heads and firmly declined, and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended an edict ordered Deng Bi to return and assist court government and again grant his former fiefs. Bi and the others knocked their heads and firmly declined, and it stopped.

sentences.zh: 於是並奉朝請，位次三公下，特進、侯上，其有大議，乃詣朝堂，與公卿參謀。

translations.literal: Thereupon they all attended court audiences, ranked below the Three Excellencies, above Specially Advanced and marquises; only when there were great deliberations did they go to the court hall and counsel with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they all attended court audiences, ranked below the Three Excellencies and above Specially Advanced and marquises. Only when there were great deliberations did they go to the court hall and counsel with the ministers.

sentences.zh: 太后詔陰後家屬皆歸故郡，還其資財五百餘萬。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered that the kin of the deposed Empress Yin all return to their native commanderies and restored to them more than five million in assets.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ordered that the kin of the deposed Empress Yin all return to their native commanderies and restored to them more than five million in assets.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，郡國十地震。

translations.literal: On bingxu, ten commanderies and states had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, ten commanderies and states had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太尉張禹免。

translations.literal: On jichou, Grand Commandant Zhang Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Grand Commandant Zhang Yu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以光祿勳穎川李修為太尉。

translations.literal: On jiashen, made Director of the Secretariat Li Xiu of Yingchuan Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Director of the Secretariat Li Xiu of Yingchuan was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 先零羌寇河東，至河內，百姓相驚，多南奔渡河，使北軍中候朱寵將五營士屯孟津，詔魏郡、趙國、常山、中山繕作塢候六百一十六所。

translations.literal: The Xianlian Qiang raided Hedong, reaching Hanoi; the people alarmed one another, many fleeing south to cross the river. Sent Central Attendant of the Northern Army Zhu Chong to lead Five Camps soldiers to encamp at Mengjin. An edict ordered Weijun, Zhao, Changshan, and Zhongshan to repair and build six hundred sixteen walled forts.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianlian Qiang raided Hedong and reached Hanoi. The people alarmed one another and many fled south across the river. Zhu Chong, Central Attendant of the Northern Army, was sent to lead Five Camps soldiers to encamp at Mengjin. An edict ordered Weijun, Zhao, Changshan, and Zhongshan to repair and build six hundred sixteen walled forts.

sentences.zh: 羌既轉盛，而緣邊二千石、令、長多內郡人，並無守戰意，皆爭上徙郡縣以避寇難。

translations.literal: As the Qiang grew ever stronger, the frontier two-thousand-bushel officials, magistrates, and chiefs were mostly men from inner commanderies, all without will to defend and fight, all competing to memorialize moving commanderies and counties to avoid bandit hardship.
translations.idiomatic: As the Qiang grew ever stronger, frontier commandery administrators and magistrates were mostly men from inner commanderies, all without will to defend and fight, and all competed to memorialize moving their commanderies and counties to avoid the bandits.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔隴西徒襄武，安定徙美陽，北地徙池陽，上郡徙衙。

translations.literal: In the third month, an edict moved Longxi to Xiangwu, Anding to Meiyang, Beidi to Chiyang, and Shang to Ya.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, an edict moved Longxi to Xiangwu, Anding to Meiyang, Beidi to Chiyang, and Shang to Ya.

sentences.zh: 百姓戀土，不樂去舊，遂乃刈其禾稼，發徹室屋，夷營壁，破積聚。

translations.literal: The people loved their land and were unwilling to leave the old places; thereupon they cut their grain, tore down houses, leveled walls and camps, and destroyed stores.
translations.idiomatic: The people loved their land and were unwilling to leave their old homes. Thereupon they cut their grain, tore down houses, leveled walls and camps, and destroyed their stores.

sentences.zh: 時連旱蝗饑荒，而驅蹙劫掠，流離分散，隨道死亡，或棄捐老弱，或為人僕妾，喪其太半。

translations.literal: At the time drought, locusts, and famine followed in succession, yet they were driven, harried, and plundered, scattered in flight along the roads, dying on the way; some abandoned the old and weak, some became others' servants and concubines—more than half were lost.
translations.idiomatic: At the time drought, locusts, and famine followed in succession, yet the people were driven, harried, and plundered, scattered along the roads and dying on the way. Some abandoned the old and weak, some became servants and concubines—more than half were lost.

sentences.zh: 復以任尚為侍御史，擊羌於上黨羊頭山，破之，乃罷孟津屯。

translations.literal: Again appointed Ren Shang Attending Clerk; he attacked the Qiang at Yangtou Mountain in Shangdang, defeated them, and then disbanded the Mengjin encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shang was again appointed Attending Clerk. He attacked the Qiang at Yangtou Mountain in Shangdang, defeated them, and then disbanded the Mengjin encampment.

sentences.zh: 夫餘王寇樂浪。

translations.literal: The king of Fuyu raided Lelang.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Fuyu raided Lelang.

sentences.zh: 高句驪王宮與濊貊寇玄菟。

translations.literal: King Gong of Gaogouli together with the Huimo raided Xuantu.
translations.idiomatic: King Gong of Gaogouli together with the Huimo raided Xuantu.

sentences.zh: 夏，閏四月，丁酉，赦涼州、河西四郡。

translations.literal: In summer, the intercalary fourth month, on dingyou, amnestied the four commanderies of Liangzhou and Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the intercalary fourth month, on dingyou day, the four commanderies of Liangzhou and Hexi were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 海郡張伯路復寇東萊，青州刺史法雄擊破之；

translations.literal: Zhang Bolu of Haip Commandery again raided Donglai; Inspector of Qingzhou Fa Xiong defeated and routed him;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bolu of Haip Commandery again raided Donglai, and Inspector of Qingzhou Fa Xiong defeated and routed him;

sentences.zh: 賊逃還遼東，遼東人李久等共斬之，於是州界清靜。

translations.literal: the bandits fled back to Liaodong; Li Jiu and others of Liaodong together beheaded them, and thereafter the province's borders were peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: the bandits fled back to Liaodong. Li Jiu and others of Liaodong together beheaded them, and thereafter the province's borders were peaceful.

sentences.zh: 秋，九月，漢陽人杜琦及弟季貢、同郡王信等與羌通謀，聚眾據上邽城。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, Du Qi of Hanyang and his younger brother Jigong, Wang Xin of the same commandery, and others conspired with the Qiang, gathered masses, and held Shanggui city.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the ninth month, Du Qi of Hanyang and his younger brother Jigong, Wang Xin of the same commandery, and others conspired with the Qiang, gathered a force, and held Shanggui city.

sentences.zh: 冬，十二月，漢陽太守趙博遣客杜習刺殺琦；

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, Administrator of Hanyang Zhao Bo sent retainer Du Xi to assassinate Qi;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, Administrator of Hanyang Zhao Bo sent retainer Du Xi to assassinate Qi;

sentences.zh: 封習討奸侯。

translations.literal: Xi was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Punished Treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Punished Treachery.

sentences.zh: 杜季貢、王信等將其眾據樗泉營。

translations.literal: Du Jigong, Wang Xin, and others led their masses to hold Chuchuan camp.
translations.idiomatic: Du Jigong, Wang Xin, and others led their forces to hold Chuchuan camp.

sentences.zh: 是歲，九州蝗，郡國八雨水。

translations.literal: This year the nine provinces suffered locusts and eight commanderies and states suffered rain floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year the nine provinces suffered locusts and eight commanderies and states suffered rain floods.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，甲寅，詔曰：「凡供薦新味，多非其節，或郁養強孰，或穿掘萌牙，味無所至而夭折生長，豈所以順時育物乎！

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jiayin, an edict said: "Whenever fresh delicacies are presented in tribute, many are not in season—some forced to ripen in warmth, some dug up as sprouts before their flavor has come, yet growth is cut off in its prime. How is this following the seasons and nurturing things!"
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on jiayin day, an edict said, "Whenever fresh delicacies are presented in tribute, many are not in season—some forced to ripen in warmth, some dug up as sprouts before their flavor has come, yet growth is cut off in its prime. How is this following the seasons and nurturing things!"

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：『非其時不食。

translations.literal: The Classic of History says: 'What is not in season, do not eat.'
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of History says, 'What is not in season, do not eat.'

sentences.zh: 』自今當奉祠陵廟及給御者，皆須時乃上。

translations.literal: " From now on what is offered at sacrifices to the imperial tombs and temples and what is supplied to the imperial table must all be presented only in season."
translations.idiomatic: " From now on what is offered at sacrifices to the imperial tombs and temples and what is supplied to the imperial table must all be presented only in season."

sentences.zh: 」凡所省二十三種。

translations.literal: " In all twenty-three kinds were abolished."
translations.idiomatic: " In all twenty-three kinds were abolished."

sentences.zh: 三月，十州蝗。

translations.literal: In the third month, ten provinces suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, ten provinces suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，乙丑，司空張敏罷。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yichou, Minister of Works Zhang Min was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on yichou day, Minister of Works Zhang Min was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以太常劉愷為司空。

translations.literal: On jimao, made Director of Ceremonies Liu Kai Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Director of Ceremonies Liu Kai was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 詔建武元功二十八將皆紹封。

translations.literal: An edict continued the enfeoffment of all twenty-eight generals of the original merit of the Jianwu era.
translations.idiomatic: An edict continued the enfeoffment of all twenty-eight founding generals of the Jianwu era.

sentences.zh: 五月，旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, there was drought.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔令中二千石下至黃綬，一切復秩。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered that from middle two-thousand-bushel officials down to those with yellow ribbons, all ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, an edict ordered that from middle two-thousand-bushel officials down to those with yellow ribbons, all ranks were restored.

sentences.zh: 六月，壬辰，豫章員谿原山崩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renchen, Mount Yuanxi at Yuanxi in Yuzhang collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen day, Mount Yuanxi at Yuanxi in Yuzhang collapsed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinsi, there was an amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, there was an amnesty for all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 侍御史唐喜討漢陽賊王信，破斬之。

translations.literal: Attending Clerk Tang Xi attacked the Hanyang bandit Wang Xin, defeated him, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Clerk Tang Xi attacked the Hanyang bandit Wang Xin, defeated him, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 杜季貢亡，從滇零。

translations.literal: Du Jigong fled and followed Dianling.
translations.idiomatic: Du Jigong fled and followed Dianling.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滇零死，子零昌立，年尚少，同種狼莫為其計策，以季貢為將軍，別居丁奚城。

translations.literal: This year Dianling died; his son Lingchang was established, still young in years. Lang Mo of the same tribe made plans for him, made Jigong general, and had him dwell separately at Dingxi city.
translations.idiomatic: That year Dianling died. His son Lingchang was established, still young in years. Lang Mo of the same tribe made plans for him, made Jigong general, and had him dwell separately at Dingxi city.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，丙午，郡國十八地震。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on bingwu, eighteen commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on bingwu day, eighteen commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，乙未，平原懷王勝薨，無子；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yiwei, Prince Huai of Pingyuan Sheng died, having no son;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on yiwei day, Prince Huai of Pingyuan Sheng died, having no son;

sentences.zh: 太后立樂安夷王寵子得為平原王。

translations.literal: the empress dowager established De, son of Prince Yi of Le'an Chong, as Prince of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager established De, son of Prince Yi of Le'an Chong, as Prince of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙申晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On bingshen the last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋，護羌校尉侯霸、騎都尉馬賢擊先零別部牢羌於安定，獲首虜千人。

translations.literal: In autumn, Protector of the Qiang Hou Ba and Commandant of Cavalry Ma Xian attacked the Laoyang, a separate division of the Xianlian, in Anding and took a thousand heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, Protector of the Qiang Hou Ba and Commandant of Cavalry Ma Xian attacked the Laoyang, a separate division of the Xianlian, in Anding and took a thousand heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts.
translations.idiomatic: There were locusts.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，甲子，改元。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jiazi, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on jiazi day, the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 二月，乙卯，日南地坼，長百餘里。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, the land of Rinan split open for more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, the land of Rinan split open for more than a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 三月，癸亥，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guihai, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔遣兵屯河內通谷衝要三十三所，皆為塢壁，設鳴鼓，以備羌寇。

translations.literal: An edict sent troops to garrison thirty-three strategic points in the Tonggu passes of Hanoi, all made into walled forts with sounding drums set up to guard against Qiang raids.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent troops to garrison thirty-three strategic points in the Tonggu passes of Hanoi, all made into walled forts with sounding drums set up to guard against Qiang raids.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁酉，赦天下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, there was an amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on dingyou day, there was an amnesty for all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 京師及郡國五旱，蝗。

translations.literal: The capital and five commanderies and states suffered drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: The capital and five commanderies and states suffered drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 五月，先零羌寇雍城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Xianlian Qiang raided Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Xianlian Qiang raided Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，蜀郡夷寇蠶陵，殺縣令。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Yi of Shujun raided Canling and killed the magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the Yi of Shujun raided Canling and killed the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 九月，乙丑，太尉李修罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yichou, Grand Commandant Li Xiu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou day, Grand Commandant Li Xiu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 羌豪號多與諸種鈔掠武都、漢中、巴郡，板楯蠻救之，漢中五官掾程信率郡兵與蠻共擊破之。

translations.literal: The Qiang chieftain Haoduo together with the various tribes raided and plundered Wudu, Hanzhong, and Bajun. The Banshun Man came to their rescue. Cheng Xin, Registrar of the Five Offices of Hanzhong, led commandery troops together with the Man and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang chieftain Haoduo together with the various tribes raided Wudu, Hanzhong, and Bajun. The Banshun Man came to their rescue. Cheng Xin, Registrar of the Five Offices of Hanzhong, led commandery troops together with the Man and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 號多走還，斷隴道，與零昌合，侯霸、馬賢與戰於枹罕，破之。

translations.literal: Haoduo fled back, cut the Long Road, and joined Lingchang. Hou Ba and Ma Xian fought them at Fuhan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Haoduo fled back, cut the Long Road, and joined Lingchang. Hou Ba and Ma Xian fought them at Fuhan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以大司農山陽司馬苞為太尉。

translations.literal: On xinwei, made Grand Minister of Agriculture Sima Bao of Shanyang Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Grand Minister of Agriculture Sima Bao of Shanyang was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day wuzi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the first day wuzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 涼州刺史皮楊擊羌於狄道，大敗，死者八百餘人。

translations.literal: Inspector of Liangzhou Pi Yang attacked the Qiang at Didao, suffered a great defeat, and more than eight hundred died.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Liangzhou Pi Yang attacked the Qiang at Didao, suffered a great defeat, and more than eight hundred died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，郡國十五地震。

translations.literal: This year fifteen commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That year fifteen commanderies and states suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 春，護羌校尉龐參以恩信招誘諸羌，號多等帥眾降；

translations.literal: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Pang Can with grace and trust summoned and induced the various Qiang; Haoduo and others led their masses to surrender;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Pang Can with grace and trust summoned and induced the various Qiang to surrender. Haoduo and others led their masses to submit;

sentences.zh: 參遣詣闕，賜號多侯印，遣之。

translations.literal: Can sent them to the palace, bestowed on Haoduo a marquis's seal, and sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: Can sent them to the capital, bestowed on Haoduo a marquis's seal, and sent him away.

sentences.zh: 參始還治令居，通河西道。

translations.literal: Can for the first time returned to administer from Lingju and opened the Hexi road.
translations.idiomatic: Can for the first time returned to administer from Lingju and opened the Hexi road.

sentences.zh: 零昌分兵寇益州，遣中郎將尹就討之。

translations.literal: Lingchang divided his troops to raid Yizhou; Gentlemen of the Palace Yin Jiu was sent to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Lingchang divided his troops to raid Yizhou. Gentlemen of the Palace Yin Jiu was sent to attack them.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丙午，立貴人滎陽閻氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingwu, established Honored Person Yan of Xingyang as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on bingwu day, Honored Person Yan of Xingyang was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 後性妒忌，後宮李氏生皇子保，後鴆殺李氏。

translations.literal: The empress was jealous by nature. Li of the rear palace bore Prince Bao; the empress poisoned and killed Lady Li.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was jealous by nature. Lady Li of the rear palace bore Prince Bao, and the empress poisoned and killed Lady Li.

sentences.zh: 五月，京師旱，河南及郡國十九蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the capital suffered drought; Henan and nineteen commanderies and states suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the capital suffered drought, and Henan and nineteen commanderies and states suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 六月，丙戌，太尉司馬苞薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingxu, Grand Commandant Sima Bao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, Grand Commandant Sima Bao died.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，辛巳，以太僕泰山馬英為太尉。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinsi, made Grand Coachman Ma Ying of Taishan Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on xinsi day, Grand Coachman Ma Ying of Taishan was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 八月，遼東鮮卑圍無慮；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Xianbei of Liaodong besieged Wulü;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Xianbei of Liaodong besieged Wulü;

sentences.zh: 九月，又攻夫犁營，殺縣令。

translations.literal: in the ninth month they again attacked Fuli camp and killed the magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: in the ninth month they again attacked Fuli camp and killed the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 壬午晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On renwu the last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 尹就擊羌黨呂叔都等，蜀人陳省、羅橫應募刺殺叔都，皆封侯，賜錢。

translations.literal: Yin Jiu attacked the Qiang partisan Lü Shudou and others. Chen Sheng and Luo Heng of Shu answered the recruitment, assassinated Shudou, and all were enfeoffed as marquises and given money.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jiu attacked the Qiang partisan Lü Shudou and others. Chen Sheng and Luo Heng of Shu answered the recruitment and assassinated Shudou. All were enfeoffed as marquises and given money.

sentences.zh: 詔屯騎校尉班雄屯三輔。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry Ban Xiong to encamp in the Three Adjuncts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry Ban Xiong to encamp in the Three Adjuncts.

sentences.zh: 雄，超之子也。

translations.literal: Xiong was the son of Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong was the son of Ban Chao.

sentences.zh: 以左馮翊司馬鈞行征西將軍，督關中諸郡兵八千餘人。

translations.literal: Made Administrator of the Left Metropolitan Area Sima Jun acting Western Expedition General, supervising more than eight thousand troops of the various commanderies of Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of the Left Metropolitan Area Sima Jun was made acting Western Expedition General, supervising more than eight thousand troops of the Guanzhong commanderies.

sentences.zh: 龐參將羌、胡兵七千餘人，與鈞分道並擊零昌。

translations.literal: Pang Can led more than seven thousand Qiang and Hu troops and with Jun divided forces to attack Lingchang together.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Can led more than seven thousand Qiang and Hu troops and with Jun divided forces to attack Lingchang together.

sentences.zh: 參兵至勇士東，為杜季貢所敗，引退。

translations.literal: Can's troops reached east of Yongshi and were defeated by Du Jigong, then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Can's troops reached east of Yongshi and were defeated by Du Jigong, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 鈞等獨進，攻拔丁奚城，杜季貢率眾偽逃。

translations.literal: Jun and the others advanced alone, attacked and took Dingxi city, and Du Jigong led his masses in a feigned flight.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and the others advanced alone, attacked and took Dingxi city, and Du Jigong led his forces in a feigned flight.

sentences.zh: 鈞令右扶風仲光等收羌禾稼，光等違鈞節度，散兵深入，羌乃設伏要擊之，鈞在城中，怒而不救。

translations.literal: Jun ordered Zhong Guang of the Right Metropolitan Area and others to gather the Qiang grain. Guang and the others violated Jun's command, scattered their troops and went deep in, and the Qiang set an ambush to intercept them. Jun was in the city, angry yet did not rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: Jun ordered Zhong Guang of the Right Metropolitan Area and others to gather the Qiang grain. Guang and the others violated Jun's command, scattered their troops and went deep in, and the Qiang set an ambush to intercept them. Jun was in the city, angry yet did not rescue them.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，乙未，光等兵敗，並沒，死者三千餘人，鈞乃遁還。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yiwei, Guang and the others' troops were defeated and all perished; more than three thousand died, and Jun then fled back.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on yiwei day, Guang and the others' troops were defeated and all perished. More than three thousand died, and Jun then fled back.

sentences.zh: 龐參既失期，稱病引還。

translations.literal: Pang Can having missed the deadline, claimed illness and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Can having missed the deadline, claimed illness and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皆坐徵，下獄，鈞自殺。

translations.literal: All were punished by summons, sent down to prison; Jun killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: All were summoned and imprisoned. Jun killed himself.

sentences.zh: 時度遼將軍梁慬亦坐事抵罪。

translations.literal: At the time Crossing-General Liang Xi also was punished by charge and suffered penalty.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Crossing-General Liang Xi was also punished on a charge.

sentences.zh: 校書郎中扶風馬融上書稱參、慬智能，宜宥過責效。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat Ma Rong of Fufeng submitted a memorial praising Can and Xi as intelligent and able, saying their faults ought to be pardoned and they required to render merit.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat Ma Rong of Fufeng submitted a memorial praising Can and Xi as intelligent and able, saying their faults ought to be pardoned and they should be required to render merit.

sentences.zh: 詔赦參等，以馬賢代參領護羌校尉，復以任尚為中郎將，代班雄屯三輔。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned Can and the others, made Ma Xian replace Can as acting Protector of the Qiang, and again made Ren Shang Gentlemen of the Palace to replace Ban Xiong in garrisoning the Three Adjuncts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned Can and the others, made Ma Xian replace Can as acting Protector of the Qiang, and again made Ren Shang Gentlemen of the Palace to replace Ban Xiong in garrisoning the Three Adjuncts.

sentences.zh: 懷令虞詡說尚曰：「兵法：弱不攻強，走不逐飛，自然之勢也。

translations.literal: Magistrate of Huai Ling Yu Xu urged Shang, saying: "The art of war: the weak do not attack the strong, what walks does not pursue what flies—this is the natural tendency."
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate of Huai Ling Yu Xu urged Shang, saying, "The art of war: the weak do not attack the strong, what walks does not pursue what flies—this is the natural tendency."

sentences.zh: 今虜皆馬騎，日行數百里，來如風雨，去如絕弦，以步追之，勢不相及，所以雖屯兵二十餘萬，曠日而無功也。

translations.literal: " Now the barbarians are all mounted, traveling several hundred li a day, coming like wind and rain, leaving like a broken bowstring. To pursue them on foot—the momentum cannot reach them. Therefore though more than two hundred thousand troops are encamped, days pass without achievement."
translations.idiomatic: " Now the barbarians are all mounted, traveling several hundred li a day, coming like wind and rain and leaving like a broken bowstring. To pursue them on foot the momentum cannot reach them. Therefore though more than two hundred thousand troops are encamped, days pass without achievement."

sentences.zh: 為使君計，莫如罷諸郡兵，各令出錢數千，二十人共市一馬，以萬騎之眾，逐數千之虜，追尾掩截，其道自究。

translations.literal: " For your lordship's plan, nothing is better than disbanding the various commandery troops and having each man contribute several thousand cash so that twenty men together buy one horse. With a host of ten thousand horsemen pursue several thousand barbarians, follow their tails and intercept them—their path will naturally be exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: " For your lordship's plan, nothing is better than disbanding the various commandery troops and having each man contribute several thousand cash so that twenty men together buy one horse. With ten thousand horsemen pursue several thousand barbarians, follow their tails and intercept them, and their path will naturally be exhausted."

sentences.zh: 便民利事，大功立矣。

translations.literal: " This benefits the people and profits the affair, and great merit is established."
translations.idiomatic: " This benefits the people and profits the affair, and great merit is established."

sentences.zh: 」尚即上言，用其計，遣輕騎擊杜季貢於丁奚城，破之。

translations.literal: " Shang at once memorialized upward and used his plan, sending light cavalry to attack Du Jigong at Dingxi city and defeating him.
translations.idiomatic: " Shang at once memorialized and used his plan, sending light cavalry to attack Du Jigong at Dingxi city and defeating him.

sentences.zh: 太后聞虞詡有將帥之略，以為武都太守，羌眾數千遮詡於陳倉崤谷，詡即停軍不進，而宣言：「上書請兵，須到當發。

translations.literal: The empress dowager heard that Yu Xu had the capacity of a commander and made him Administrator of Wudu. Several thousand Qiang blocked Xu at Chencang in the Xiaogu pass. Xu at once halted his army and did not advance, yet proclaimed: "I have memorialized requesting troops; when they arrive I shall set out."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager heard that Yu Xu had the capacity of a commander and made him Administrator of Wudu. Several thousand Qiang blocked Xu at Chencang in the Xiaogu pass. Xu at once halted his army and did not advance, yet proclaimed, "I have memorialized requesting troops. When they arrive I shall set out."

sentences.zh: 」羌聞之，乃分鈔傍縣。

translations.literal: " When the Qiang heard this, they divided to raid neighboring counties.
translations.idiomatic: " When the Qiang heard this, they divided to raid neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 詡因其兵散，日夜進道，兼行百餘里，令吏士各作兩灶，日增倍之，羌不敢逼。

translations.literal: Xu, because their troops were scattered, advanced day and night, making more than a hundred li in double marches, and ordered officers and soldiers each to make two cooking pits, doubling them daily. The Qiang did not dare press him.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, because their troops were scattered, advanced day and night, making more than a hundred li in double marches, and ordered officers and soldiers each to make two cooking pits, doubling them daily. The Qiang did not dare press him.

sentences.zh: 或問曰：「孫臏減灶而君增之，兵法日行不過三十里，以戒不虞，而今日且二百里，何也？

translations.literal: Someone asked: "Sun Bin reduced cooking pits yet you increase them. The art of war says a day's march does not exceed thirty li to guard against the unexpected—yet today you go nearly two hundred li. Why?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked, "Sun Bin reduced cooking pits yet you increase them. The art of war says a day's march does not exceed thirty li to guard against the unexpected—yet today you go nearly two hundred li. Why?"

sentences.zh: 」詡曰：「虜眾多，吾兵少，徐行則易為所及，速進則彼所不測。

translations.literal: " Xu said: "The barbarians are many, our troops few. If we go slowly we are easily caught; if we advance swiftly they cannot measure us."
translations.idiomatic: " Xu said, "The barbarians are many and our troops few. If we go slowly we are easily caught; if we advance swiftly they cannot measure us."

sentences.zh: 虜見吾灶日增，必謂郡兵來迎，眾多行速，必憚追我。

translations.literal: " When the barbarians see our pits increase daily, they will surely think commandery troops come to meet us. Many men traveling fast—they will surely fear to pursue me."
translations.idiomatic: " When the barbarians see our pits increase daily, they will surely think commandery troops come to meet us. Many men traveling fast—they will surely fear to pursue me."

sentences.zh: 孫臏見弱，吾今示強，勢有不同故也。

translations.literal: " Sun Bin showed weakness; I now show strength—the momentum has different causes."
translations.idiomatic: " Sun Bin showed weakness; I now show strength—the situation differs."

sentences.zh: 」既到郡，兵不滿三千，而羌眾萬餘，攻圍赤亭數十日。

translations.literal: " When he had reached the commandery, his troops were fewer than three thousand while Qiang masses were more than ten thousand, attacking and besieging Chiting for several tens of days.
translations.idiomatic: " When he reached the commandery, his troops were fewer than three thousand while Qiang masses were more than ten thousand, attacking and besieging Chiting for several tens of days.

sentences.zh: 詡乃令軍中，強弩勿發，而潛發小弩；

translations.literal: Xu thereupon ordered the army not to loose strong crossbows but secretly to loose small crossbows;
translations.idiomatic: Xu thereupon ordered the army not to loose strong crossbows but secretly to loose small crossbows;

sentences.zh: 羌以為矢力弱，不能至，並兵急攻。

translations.literal: the Qiang thought the arrows' force was weak and could not reach them, massed their troops, and pressed the attack urgently.
translations.idiomatic: the Qiang thought the arrows' force was weak and could not reach them, massed their troops, and pressed the attack urgently.

sentences.zh: 詡於是使二十強弩共射一人，發無不中，羌大震，退。

translations.literal: Xu thereupon had twenty strong crossbows shoot one man together; none missed, and the Qiang were greatly shaken and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Xu thereupon had twenty strong crossbows shoot one man together. None missed, and the Qiang were greatly shaken and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 詡因出城奮擊，多所傷殺。

translations.literal: Xu then went out of the city and struck fiercely, wounding and killing many.
translations.idiomatic: Xu then went out of the city and struck fiercely, wounding and killing many.

sentences.zh: 明日，悉陳其兵眾，令從東郭門出，北郭門入，貿易衣服，回轉數周；

translations.literal: Next day he arrayed all his troops, ordered them out through the eastern gate and in through the northern gate, exchanged clothes, and wheeled about several circuits;
translations.idiomatic: The next day he arrayed all his troops, ordered them out through the eastern gate and in through the northern gate, exchanged clothes, and wheeled about several circuits;

sentences.zh: 羌不知其數，更相恐動。

translations.literal: the Qiang did not know their number and alarmed one another ever more.
translations.idiomatic: the Qiang did not know their number and alarmed one another ever more.

sentences.zh: 詡計賊當退，乃潛遣五百餘人於淺水設伏，候其走路；

translations.literal: Xu calculated the bandits would withdraw, then secretly sent more than five hundred men to set an ambush in shallow water and wait for their escape route;
translations.idiomatic: Xu calculated the bandits would withdraw, then secretly sent more than five hundred men to set an ambush in shallow water and wait for their escape route;

sentences.zh: 虜果大奔，因掩擊，大破之，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: the barbarians indeed fled in great disorder; he thereupon struck from ambush, routed them greatly, and beheaded and captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: the barbarians indeed fled in great disorder. He struck from ambush, routed them greatly, and beheaded and captured very many.

sentences.zh: 賊由是敗散。

translations.literal: The rebels thereby were defeated and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were thereby defeated and scattered.

sentences.zh: 詡乃占相地勢，築營壁百八十所，招還流亡，假賑貧民，開通水運。

translations.literal: Xu thereupon surveyed and assessed the terrain, built one hundred eighty fortified camps, summoned back the displaced, lent grain to relieve the poor, and opened water transport.
translations.idiomatic: Xu thereupon surveyed the terrain, built one hundred eighty fortified camps, summoned back refugees, lent grain to relieve the poor, and opened water transport.

sentences.zh: 詡始到郡，谷石千，鹽石八千，見戶萬三千；

translations.literal: When Xu first arrived at the commandery, grain was a thousand per picul, salt eight thousand per picul, and registered households thirteen thousand;
translations.idiomatic: When Xu first arrived at the commandery, grain cost a thousand cash per picul, salt eight thousand per picul, and registered households numbered thirteen thousand;

sentences.zh: 視事三年，米石八十，鹽石四百，民增至四萬餘戶，人足家給，一郡遂安。

translations.literal: After three years in office, rice was eighty per picul, salt four hundred per picul, the people increased to more than forty thousand households, people had enough and households were provided for, and the whole commandery was then at peace.
translations.idiomatic: After three years in office, rice cost eighty cash per picul and salt four hundred per picul; the population increased to more than forty thousand households, people had enough and households were provided for, and the whole commandery was at peace.

sentences.zh: 十一月，庚申，郡國十地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengshen day, ten commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen day, ten commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十二月，武陵澧中蠻反，州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Lízhōng barbarians of Wuling rebelled; the province and commanderies subdued them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Lízhōng barbarians of Wuling rebelled; the province and commanderies subdued them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，司徒夏勤罷，庚戌，以司空劉愷為司徒，光祿勳袁敞為司空。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Grand Tutor Xia Qin was dismissed; on gengxu day, Minister of Works Liu Kai was made Grand Tutor, and Household Minister Yuan Chang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Grand Tutor Xia Qin was dismissed; on gengxu day Minister of Works Liu Kai was made Grand Tutor, and Household Minister Yuan Chang was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 敞，安之子也。

translations.literal: Chang was the son of An.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was the son of Yuan An.

sentences.zh: 前虎賁中郎將鄧弘卒。

translations.literal: Former Colonel of the Rapid Horses in the Tiger Guard Deng Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: Former Colonel of the Rapid Horses in the Tiger Guard Deng Hong died.

sentences.zh: 弘性儉素，治歐陽《尚書》，授帝禁中。

translations.literal: Hong's nature was frugal and plain; he studied Ouyang's Documents and instructed the Emperor within the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Hong was frugal and plain by nature; he studied Ouyang's Documents and instructed the Emperor within the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 有司奏贈弘驃騎將軍，位特進，封西平侯。

translations.literal: The responsible offices memorialized to posthumously grant Hong General of the Agile Cavalry, position as Specialist-in-Chief, and enfeoffment as Marquis of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices memorialized to posthumously grant Hong the title General of the Agile Cavalry, position as Specialist-in-Chief, and enfeoffment as Marquis of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 太后追弘雅意，不加贈位、衣服，但賜錢千萬，布萬匹；

translations.literal: The empress dowager, recalling Hong's refined intent, did not add posthumous rank or robes, but only bestowed ten million cash and ten thousand bolts of cloth;
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, recalling Hong's refined simplicity, did not grant posthumous rank or burial robes, but only bestowed ten million cash and ten thousand bolts of cloth;

sentences.zh: 兄騭等復辭不受。

translations.literal: his elder brother Zhi and others again declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Zhi and others again declined and would not accept.

sentences.zh: 詔封弘子廣德為西平侯。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Hong's son Guangde as Marquis of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Hong's son Guangde as Marquis of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 將葬，有司復奏發五營輕車騎士，禮儀如霍光故事。

translations.literal: When about to bury him, the responsible offices again memorialized to dispatch light chariot and horse cavalry from the five camps, the rites and ceremony following Huo Guang's precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to be buried, the responsible offices again memorialized to dispatch light chariot and horse cavalry from the five camps, with rites and ceremony following Huo Guang's precedent.

sentences.zh: 太后皆不聽，但白蓋雙騎，門生輓送。

translations.literal: The empress dowager would not approve any of it, allowing only white canopy and double riders, with his students drawing the bier in escort.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager would not approve any of it, allowing only a white canopy and two horsemen, with his students serving as pallbearers.

sentences.zh: 後以帝師之重，分西平之都鄉，封廣德弟甫德為都鄉侯。

translations.literal: Later, in view of the weight of being the Emperor's teacher, the Capital Township of Xiping was separated out and Guangde's younger brother Fude was enfeoffed as Marquis of Duxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in view of the weight of his office as the Emperor's teacher, the Capital Township of Xiping was separated out and Guangde's younger brother Fude was enfeoffed as Marquis of Duxiang.
